title: Clarity doesn’t always come from learning something new.
caption:
Clarity doesn’t always come from learning something new.
Sometimes, it comes from removing what was clouding the heart.

When the heart is polished, truth no longer feels distant. It becomes familiar. Quiet. Almost like coming home.

That is the return — from illusion back to what was always real.
Taking My Soul Home.

#TakingMySoulHome #HeartPurification #SpiritualClarity #InnerAwakening #SoulAwareness

title: Sometimes the hardest illusion to break is the one we built inside ourselves.
caption:
Sometimes the hardest illusion to break is the one we built inside ourselves.

The ego creates stories. The heart carries them.
But when the heart begins to clear, those stories lose their power.

And suddenly, what once felt confusing becomes unmistakably clear.

Not because the world changed.
Because the way you see it did.

#TwoVoicesInsideYou #SoulVsEgo #DelusionPurified #SpiritualSelfAwareness #InnerTransformation
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: I built stories to protect myself.
caption:
I built stories to protect myself.

Stories about who I was.
What happened.
What they meant.
What I deserved.

And for a while, I believed every one of them.

But now the cracks are showing.

Maybe truth doesn't destroy me.
Maybe it finally sets me free.

#EgoAwareness #BreakingTheIllusion #InnerShadowWork #EgoHealing #ConsciousAwakenin

title: The companions asked the Prophet ﷺ how they should send blessings upon him.
caption:
The companions asked the Prophet ﷺ how they should send blessings upon him.

And he taught them.

From that teaching comes the beautiful form of salawat known today as Durood Ibrahim.

Not invented later.
Not merely poetic tradition.
But rooted in an authentic Prophetic instruction.

To recite it is to repeat words the Messenger ﷺ himself taught his companions.

May Allah make our salawat sincere, increase our love for His Messenger ﷺ, and make that love visible in our character and obedience.

𝒥𝓊𝓂𝓂𝒶𝒽 𝑀𝓊𝒷𝒶𝓇𝒶𝓀.

#DuroodIbrahim #Salawat #JummahMubarak #Sunnah #ProphetMuhammad

title: This Friday, pause with one of the most beloved forms of salawat taught by the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
caption:
This Friday, pause with one of the most beloved forms of salawat taught by the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

درودِ ابراہیمی

A prayer of love.
A prayer of honour.
A prayer that connects the believer to the Messenger ﷺ through remembrance and devotion.

Let Freha Wahla’s recitation become a moment to slow down, listen deeply, and send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ with presence of heart.

𝗝𝘂𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗵 𝗠𝘂𝗯𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗸 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝘂𝘀𝗹𝗶𝗺 𝗨𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗵, 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱.

#JummahMubarak #DuroodIbrahim #Salawat #LoveForTheProphet #FridayDhikr

title: Salawat is not merely a beautiful tradition.
caption:
Salawat is not merely a beautiful tradition.

It is a command from Allah.

A call to remember His Messenger ﷺ with love, reverence, and prayer.

This Friday, let your heart slow down enough to send blessings upon the one who carried the message of mercy to us.

May every salawat deepen our love for the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and bring more sincerity into the way we follow his Sunnah.

𝒥𝓊𝓂𝓂𝒶𝒽 𝑀𝓊𝒷𝒶𝓇𝒶𝓀.

#JummahMubarak #Salawat #ProphetMuhammad #QuranReminder #IslamicReminder

title: Sometimes we don't need another answer.
caption:
Sometimes we don't need another answer.

We need a place where the noise finally becomes quiet.

The People of the Cave remind us that running toward Allah is never running away from life.

Sometimes, it is running toward the only refuge that can hold us.

𝗔 𝗯𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗿𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗻.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #ThePeopleOfTheCave #IslamicReminder #Allah

title: They fled with nothing but faith.
caption:
They fled with nothing but faith.

And Allah turned a cave into a sanctuary.

What looked like darkness became protection.
What looked like hiding became refuge.
What looked like a narrow cave became wider than the world they had escaped.

Perhaps that's the reminder we need too:

When your heart runs to Allah, even your smallest refuge can become a place of mercy.

🎧 𝗪𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵 𝗘𝗽𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗱𝗲 𝟮𝟳 — 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗮𝘃𝗲.

#FaithInDarkness #CaveOfRefuge #TrustInAllah #ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome

title: May the places where you feel alone become places where you feel held.
caption:
May the places where you feel alone become places where you feel held.

May your fear return to trust.

May your loneliness return to nearness.

And may Allah take your soul Home to the refuge that comes only from Him.

Aameen ya Rabbal ‘Aalameen.

#HealingJourney #FaithAndTrust #FromLonelinessToLove #SpiritualRefuge #Aameen

title: Some days, you're not giving up. You're just tired of being strong for so long.
caption:
Some days, you're not giving up. You're just tired of being strong for so long.

You keep showing up. You keep trying. You keep carrying things that nobody else can see.

And sometimes, all you can ask is, “When will life finally feel lighter?”

You don't need perfect words to express what is in your heart. Honest prayers can begin with a single question.

If today feels heavy, give yourself permission to pause, breathe, and seek comfort in Allah.

You are allowed to feel tired without losing hope.

Save this reminder for the days when you need it most. 🤍

#TakingMySoulHome #TmySH #IslamicReminder #TrustAllah #Dua

title: “Ya Allah… when will my tough days end?”
caption:
“Ya Allah… when will my tough days end?”

Sometimes, that question comes from a heart that is still trying — a heart that has not given up, but simply needs reassurance.

In Episode 20 of Let’s Tell Allah, we reflect on a beautiful promise from the Qur’an:
فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
“Indeed, with hardship comes ease.” — Qur’an 94:6

This verse reminds us to hold on to hope through difficult days. We may not know when our circumstances will change, but hardship is not the whole story.

Keep turning to Allah with honesty. Keep taking the next small step. Let hope remain alive in your heart.

May this reminder reach someone who needs it today. 🤍
Save it, share it, and return to it whenever life feels heavy.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #TrustInAllah #Sabr #HopeInAllah

title: A gentle reminder for anyone going through a difficult season:
caption:
A gentle reminder for anyone going through a difficult season:
Your struggles are real. You don't have to minimize them or pretend they don't hurt.
But don't let a difficult chapter convince you that your entire story will remain this way.

Allah says in the Qur’an:
“Indeed, with hardship comes ease.” — Qur’an 94:6

When the road feels long, focus on what you can do today. Make du’a. Seek support when you need it. Take one small, meaningful step forward.

Hope doesn't require you to know exactly how everything will work out. Sometimes, it simply means refusing to believe that hardship is the end of your story.

What is one small thing that helps you hold on to hope during difficult days? Share it in the comments — your words might help someone else.

#QuranQuotes #IslamicQuotes #DailyIslamicReminder #SabrAndShukr #TakingMySoulHom

title: Sometimes the weight isn't in what you're carrying.
caption:
Sometimes the weight isn't in what you're carrying.

It's in how small the world has made you feel.

Pressure. Comparison. Expectations.
And slowly, the heart forgets that it was created for something higher.

What if the heaviness you're feeling isn't the end of your story?

Stay with this.
Come back to it when life feels low.

Follow Taking My Soul Home for the journey through the Names.

#MercifulShades #AlAli #IslamicSpirituality #HeartAwakening #TakingMySoulHome

title: ٱلْعَلِيُّ
caption:
ٱلْعَلِيُّ

The Sublime.
The High One.

His elevation reminds the heart that being near Him doesn't require escaping the world.

Sometimes elevation begins quietly —
with truth, remembrance, surrender, and the courage to rise again.

You thought you were falling.

Perhaps your heart was being taught how to rise.

Reflect on this Name. Save it. Come back when you need it.

#NamesOfAllah #AlAliyy #IslamicReflection #SpiritualReturn #MercifulShades

title: What if falling doesn't mean you've been forgotten?
caption:
What if falling doesn't mean you've been forgotten?

What if weakness doesn't make your return less worthy?

“When we fall, elevate us.”
A prayer for the moments when the heart feels low, the mind feels tired, and the path ahead feels unclear.

May we remember where we came from.
May we remember Who we are turning toward.
And may we keep rising.

Stay with this prayer.
Save it for a day when you need to come back.

#DuaAndDhikr #YaAliyy #IslamicDua #ReturnToAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: Freedom doesn't begin when you finally possess everything you desire.
caption:
Freedom doesn't begin when you finally possess everything you desire.

It begins when you stop believing that everything must remain yours.

The Soul understands that attachment is not love, and letting go is not losing.

When your hands open, your heart discovers something deeper than possession: trust in the One who is always sufficient.

Sometimes, the greatest freedom is simply learning to hold nothing but faith.
Taking My Soul Home.

#AttachmentPurified #SpiritualSurrender #InnerFreedom #TrustInAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: What if losing your grip was never the same as losing everything?
caption:
What if losing your grip was never the same as losing everything?

The Ego fears letting go because it believes possession creates security.

But the Soul discovers a different truth:
You don't need to hold everything to be whole.
You don't need to control everything to feel safe.
And you don't need to cling when your heart learns to rely upon Allah.

True freedom begins where attachment ends.

Episode 26 — Attachment Purified.

“Whoever relies on Allah — He will suffice them.” (Qur’an 64:11)

#SoulVsEgo #AttachmentPurified #IslamicSpirituality #EmotionalFreedom #TakingMySoulHome

title: I keep holding on.
caption:
I keep holding on.

To people. To expectations. To things I was never meant to control.

I tell myself it's love. Sometimes, it's just fear wearing the mask of attachment.

Because what if I let go?
What if nothing remains?

But perhaps the thing I'm afraid of losing is the very thing keeping me from finding peace.

Maybe open hands aren't empty.
Maybe they're finally free.

#EgoAwareness #FearOfLettingGo #AttachmentHealing #InnerConflict #SoulVsEgo

title: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke of those who remember Allah often—and named them among the Mufarridūn, those who have gone ahead.
caption:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke of those who remember Allah often—and named them among the Mufarridūn, those who have gone ahead.

Let this Friday be a gentle invitation to remember Allah more: not only with the tongue, but with attention, humility, and sincerity.

لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ

#TmySH #JummahMubarak #Hadith #Dhikr #RememberAllah

title: A quiet moment. A sincere heart. A remembrance that brings us back to what matters most.
caption:
A quiet moment. A sincere heart. A remembrance that brings us back to what matters most.

Listen to Freha Wahla recite:
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ

May these words be more than something we hear—may they be remembered with the heart and reflected in the way we live.

Jummah Mubarak.

#TmySH #JummahMubarak #LaIlahaIllallah #Dhikr #FrehaWahla

title: Some words are more than words. They bring the heart back to the One it was made to remember.
caption:
Some words are more than words. They bring the heart back to the One it was made to remember.

“لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ” — a declaration of faith, repeated with presence and sincerity.

May our hearts find their stillness in the remembrance of Allah.

#TmySH #JummahMubarak #Dhikr #RemembranceOfAllah #IslamicReminder

title: Fear can rise suddenly.
caption:
Fear can rise suddenly.

Even in moments of faith, the heart can tremble.

But fear does not have to become our destination.

Sometimes, the first step toward courage is simply turning that fear back toward Allah.

“Do not fear.”

May every fear within us find its way back to Him.

Aameen ya Rabbal ‘Aalameen.

#TmySH #Fear #Heart #Courage #TakingMySoulHome

title: In this breath, we remember Musa (AS) — a moment of fear, a command to trust, and a transformation that reminds us that courage does not mean never being afraid.
caption:
In this breath, we remember Musa (AS) — a moment of fear, a command to trust, and a transformation that reminds us that courage does not mean never being afraid.

Sometimes, courage is simply fear returning to Allah.

May our anxieties return to surrender.
May our trembling return to trust.
And may our fear become the doorway through which courage enters.

Take our souls Home to the courage that comes only from You.

Aameen ya Rabbal ‘Aalameen.

#Allah #Musa #Fear #TmySH #TakingMySoulHome

title: Perhaps courage isn't the absence of fear.
caption:
Perhaps courage isn't the absence of fear.

Perhaps it is what happens when we stop carrying our fear alone.

We surrender it.
We trust Him with it.
And slowly, what once made us tremble begins to make us stronger.

May Allah replace our fear with trust, our anxiety with surrender, and our trembling with courage.

Aameen ya Rabbal ‘Aalameen.

#ABreathOfReturn #Courage #Surrender #Trust #TakingMySoulHome

title: A distracted moment does not have to become a distant heart.
caption:
A distracted moment does not have to become a distant heart.

Sometimes, the most meaningful act of faith is simply noticing that your attention has drifted—and choosing to turn back to Allah.

Don’t let one moment of weakness convince you that you’ve lost your way. Return through duʿā, remembrance, and small sincere steps.

Your heart can always turn back towards the One who guides it.

Save this reminder for the moments when you feel spiritually distracted. Share it with someone who needs encouragement today.

#SpiritualReminder #IslamicReminder #ReturnToAllah #Faith #TakingMySoulHome

title: What if your greatest fear isn’t falling—but slowly drifting away from Allah?
caption:
What if your greatest fear isn’t falling—but slowly drifting away from Allah?

In Episode 19 of Let’s Tell Allah, a quiet worry becomes a heartfelt duʿā: the fear of being distracted, weakened, or pulled away from the straight path.

And the reminder comes from the Qur’an:

 إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ 

“He has no authority over those who believe and trust in their Lord.”
— Qur’an 16:99

A reminder that fear does not have to lead your heart. Keep turning to Allah, strengthening your faith, and placing your trust in Him.

Let’s tell Allah what weighs on our hearts.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #TrustInAllah #Shaytan #IslamicVideo

title: When you fear being pulled away from the straight path, remember this powerful promise from Allah:
caption:
When you fear being pulled away from the straight path, remember this powerful promise from Allah:

 إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ 

“He has no authority over those who believe and trust in their Lord.”
— Qur’an 16:99

This verse reminds us to place our trust in Allah—not in fear, not in whispers, and not in the uncertainty of tomorrow.

Keep your heart connected to Allah. Seek His guidance. Return to Him whenever you feel distracted.

A reminder worth saving—and sharing with someone who needs strength in their faith.

#QuranVerse #TrustInAllah #Tawakkul #QuranReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: What if the smallest thing you did today mattered more than you imagined?
caption:
What if the smallest thing you did today mattered more than you imagined?

A quiet smile.
A prayer whispered through tears.
A kindness nobody noticed.
An effort nobody acknowledged.

Sometimes, we measure our deeds by their size. We wonder whether they were enough. Whether anyone saw them.

But sincerity is never measured by applause.

Perhaps the act you almost forgot is the one your heart needed to remember.

Stay with this thought.

Your smallest good deed is worth reflecting upon. Save this reminder for the days when your efforts feel unseen.

Follow **@IamAaliJah** as we journey through the Merciful Shades of the Beloved.

#AshShakur #SincereDeeds #IslamicReminders #Tazkiyah #TakingMySoulHome

title: You thought your deed was small.
caption:
You thought your deed was small.

But have you considered the greatness of the One receiving it?

ٱلشَّكُورُ — Ash-Shakūr.

The One who appreciates every sincere act. The One whose generosity exceeds our expectations.

Remember the story of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه.

During the hardship of Tabūk, his generosity became an unforgettable expression of sincerity.

His story reminds us that giving is not merely about what leaves our hands. It is about what lives within our hearts.

What matters is not how much the world sees.

It is the sincerity with which we return to Him.

Reflect on this Divine Name today.

What is one small act of goodness you want to remain consistent in?

#AshShakur #NamesOfAllah #IslamicSpirituality #SincerityInIslam #MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved

title: What if gratitude begins when we stop asking whether our deeds are enough?
caption:
What if gratitude begins when we stop asking whether our deeds are enough?

Ya Shakūr…

Receive our small deeds with Your vast mercy.

A smile — give us ease. 
A tear — give us healing. 
A moment of remembrance — give us light.

Let our intentions remain pure, even when our efforts go unseen.

And when our hearts grow tired, remind us that every sincere return matters.

May we become people who give quietly, remember deeply, and remain grateful through every season.

Ameen yā Rabb al-ʿĀlamīn.

Save this dua. Return to it whenever your heart needs a reminder.

Follow **Taking My Soul Home** for more journeys through the Beautiful Names of Allah.

#DuaAndDhikr #AshShakur #IslamicDua #GratefulHeart #SpiritualReturn

title: You don’t have to see every step before you take the next one.
caption:
You don’t have to see every step before you take the next one.

Sometimes certainty isn’t knowing where the road ends.
It’s remembering Who is guiding you.

Fear asks, “What if I can’t see the way?”
The Soul quietly answers, “Keep walking.”

And sometimes, the path appears only after you trust enough to move.

#TrustInAllah #SpiritualSurrender #SoulAwakening #InnerGuidance #TakingMySoulHome

title: Fear does not always disappear because the unknown becomes clear.
caption:
Fear does not always disappear because the unknown becomes clear.

Sometimes it dissolves because you remember Who holds you.

The Ego wants certainty before taking a step.
The Soul learns to walk with trust.

And when you surrender the need to see everything, the path you could not see before begins to open.

Episode 25 — Fear Purified.

#FearPurified #TrustTheJourney #SpiritualTransformation #SoulVsEgo #TakingMySoulHome

title: I keep asking for proof before I move.
caption:
I keep asking for proof before I move.

I want to see the road.
I want to know where it ends.
I want certainty before I take another step.

Because what if the path disappears?

But maybe that’s what fear does…
it makes me believe I need to see everything before I can trust anything.

Maybe I only need to take the next step.

#FearAndFaith #EgoAwareness #LetGoOfFear #InnerHealingJourney #SoulVsEgo

title: You sent one whisper.
caption:
You sent one whisper.
Heaven answered with ten.

It's easy to feel unseen, unheard, small.
But a single blessing upon the Beloved ﷺ
returns to you multiplied by the Lord of the worlds.

Nothing you offer in love is ever lost.

Sahih Muslim 408a

#JummahMubarak #Whisper #ProphetMuhammad #TmySH #TakingMySoulHome

title: Some words don't need to be understood to be felt.
caption:
Some words don't need to be understood to be felt.

A voice. A whisper.
Salli ala Sayyidina.
Send blessings upon our master.

Say it once.
Then let your heart say it again.

Jumma Mubarak ✦
May this Friday return you to Him, one salawat at a time.

Voice: Freha Wahla

#JummahPrayer #SalliAlaSayyidina #JummahMubarak #Salawat #TakingMySoulHome

title: Before you were ever asked to send blessings,
caption:
Before you were ever asked to send blessings,
Allah had already done so.

Then the angels.
Then, gently, an invitation to you.

Not a burden. An honor.

Today, join a gathering that began long before you.

Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:56
