title: You don't need to know how everything will unfold.
caption:
You don't need to know how everything will unfold.

Sometimes the hardest part isn't the path itself — it's accepting that we can't see where it leads.

Tawakkul is learning to place your trust in Allah even when the next chapter is still hidden from you.

You may not see the whole path.
Allah does.

And sometimes, that's enough.

“Whoever puts their trust in Allah — He is enough for them.”
— Qur’an 65:3

Save this for the days when uncertainty feels heavier than it should. 🤍

#Allah #QuranReminder #IslamicQuotes #IslamicContent #TakingMySoulHome

title: Sometimes you don't need another answer.
caption:
Sometimes you don't need another answer.
You need a heart that can trust Allah.

In Episode 18 of Let’s Tell Allah, Ayesha stands at a crossroads — unsure of what tomorrow holds, but certain of where she wants to turn.

She doesn't ask Allah to reveal the entire path.

She asks for something deeper:

the ability to walk forward without fear.

And then comes the reminder:

“Whoever puts their trust in Allah — He is enough for them.”
Qur’an 65:3

Episode 18 — TRUST

A reminder for anyone standing between what they know and what they don't yet know.

#LetsTellAllah #IslamicReminder #IslamicContent #SpiritualJourney #TakingMySoulHome

title: Be honest — do you struggle to trust Allah when you can't see what's coming next?
caption:
Be honest — do you struggle to trust Allah when you can't see what's coming next?

We often want certainty before we take the next step.

We want to know:

Will this work?
Will I be okay?
What happens next?
Am I making the right choice?

But faith doesn't always come with a complete map.

Sometimes, all we can do is take the next step with tawakkul — trusting Allah while the rest of the road remains unseen.

Qur’an 65:3 reminds us:

“Whoever puts their trust in Allah — He is enough for them.”

So here's today's question:

What are you trying to control because you're afraid to trust Allah with it?

You don't have to answer publicly.
Just sit with the question.

#Tawakkul #TrustAllah #Allah #Faith #TakingMySoulHome

title: Sometimes the mistake stays in your mind longer than it should.
caption:
Sometimes the mistake stays in your mind longer than it should.

You replay it.
You carry it.
You wonder if you’ve gone too far.

But Al-Ghafūr reminds the heart that a past chapter is not the whole story.

You can still return.
You can still soften.
You can still come Home.

Stay with this. Then come back to it whenever your heart feels heavy.

#AlGhafur #IslamicSpirituality #TawbahJourney #HeartHealing #TakingMySoulHome

title: ٱلْغَفُورُ — Al-Ghafūr.
caption:
ٱلْغَفُورُ — Al-Ghafūr.

The All-Forgiving.

A Name that invites us to look beyond the version of ourselves we regret.

Not to forget what happened.
Not to excuse what was wrong.

But to understand that forgiveness can become the beginning of transformation.

What if the chapter you are ashamed of is not where your story ends?

Reflect on Al-Ghafūr today. Save this for the moment you need to remember.

#AlGhafur #AsmaUlHusna #IslamicReminders #SpiritualReturn #TmySH

title: Ya Ghafūr…
caption:
Ya Ghafūr…

Cover what we wish we could undo.
Turn our regret into wisdom.
Turn our wounds into openings toward You.

Sometimes returning does not begin with having everything figured out.

It begins with one quiet step toward Him.

One softened heart.
One sincere breath.
One return.

Come back to this prayer whenever you need it.

#DuaAndDhikr #AlGhafur #IslamicDua #SoulfulIslam #MercifulShades

title: Not every strong emotion needs to be silenced.
caption:
Not every strong emotion needs to be silenced.
Some must be purified, disciplined, and given a righteous purpose.

When anger stops serving the ego and begins protecting what is right, its nature changes.

The Soul does not ask you to become powerless.
It teaches you where your power belongs.

#RighteousAnger #SpiritualDiscipline #SoulAwakening #InnerPurification #TakingMySoulHome

title: There is a difference between anger that destroys and anger that protects.
caption:
There is a difference between anger that destroys and anger that protects.

In this episode, the fire within begins to change. It no longer burns simply because it is hurt. It learns restraint. It learns purpose. It learns that strength does not mean destruction.

Sometimes the goal isn't to extinguish the fire.
It's to teach it what deserves to burn.

#AngerPurified #SoulVsEgo #SpiritualGrowthJourney #EmotionalMastery #TakingMySoulHome

title: I used to burn everything when I was hurt.
caption:
I used to burn everything when I was hurt.

Now I'm learning the difference between destruction and protection.

Not every battle deserves my fire.
Not every wound deserves a reaction.

Maybe strength isn't having no anger.

Maybe it's finally knowing what my fire is for.

#EgoTransformation #EmotionalHealing #InnerWorkJourney #SelfAwarenessPath #SoulVsEgo

title: There is an hour on Friday worth searching for.
caption:
There is an hour on Friday worth searching for.

Not with noise.
Not with haste.
But with a heart that knows where to turn.

So make du‘a.
For what you need.
For what you cannot say aloud.
For the people you love.
For forgiveness, guidance, mercy and a heart that remains close to Allah.

Some prayers are whispered only once.
Some are carried for years.

Keep asking.

Jummah Mubarak. 🤍

#FridayDua #JummahMubarak #Dua #IslamicReminder #FridayPrayer

title: To every heart that turns toward Allah this Friday —
caption:
To every heart that turns toward Allah this Friday —
wherever you are, whatever you are carrying,
may this Jummah bring you a little closer to Him.

May your prayers be sincere,
your heart be softened,
your home be filled with barakah,
and your Friday be wrapped in peace.

Jummah Mubarak to the Muslim community and to Muslims around the world.

#JummahMubarak #BlessedFriday #FridayReminder #IslamicPost #MuslimUmmah

title: Friday arrives with a quiet invitation:
caption:
Friday arrives with a quiet invitation:
to step away from the noise, the work, the rushing — and turn back toward Allah.

When the call to Jumu’ah is heard, the Qur’an reminds us what deserves our attention most: the remembrance of Allah.

May this Friday bring stillness to our hearts, barakah to our homes, and sincerity to our worship.

Jummah Mubarak. 🤍

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #QuranReminder #IslamicReminder #RememberAllah

title: You made a mistake. That doesn't make you a mistake.
caption:
You made a mistake. That doesn't make you a mistake.

Sometimes we replay one sentence, one reaction, one decision — and let it become the way we see ourselves.

But regret can become a turning point when it brings the heart back to Allah.

Acknowledge what happened.
Learn from it.
Seek forgiveness.
Make things right where you can.
And keep walking.

Your mistake is something you did.
It is not the entirety of who you are.

Save this for the day regret feels heavier than it should. 🤍

#Allah #IslamicQuotes #Forgiveness #IslamicContent #TakingMySoulHome

title: WHEN I MADE A MISTAKE.
caption:
WHEN I MADE A MISTAKE.

There are moments when the heart becomes quiet after we realize:

“I shouldn't have said that.”
“I could have handled that differently.”
“I wish I had responded with more kindness.”

Not every mistake means you're lost.

Sometimes, the most honest thing you can say is simply:

“Ya Allah… I made a mistake.”

And then return.

Episode 17 of Let’s Tell Allah is a quiet reminder that regret doesn't have to become despair.

Allah says:

وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ 

“Do not despair of Allah’s mercy.”
Qur’an 12:87

The mistake didn't define him.

Allah's mercy did.

🤍

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #AllahsMercy #Quran #Tawbah

title: What do you do after you make a mistake?
caption:
What do you do after you make a mistake?

Do you replay it a hundred times?

Do you punish yourself?

Do you convince yourself that you've gone too far?

Or do you turn back?

A mistake can become a doorway to something better when it leads you toward sincere tawbah, humility and a closer relationship with Allah.

Admit it.
Ask forgiveness.
Repair what you can.
Learn from it.
Then begin again.

Don't let regret become the reason you stay away from Allah.

His mercy is greater than the moment you're ashamed of.

Save this reminder for later. 🤍

#AllahsMercy #Repentance #MuslimReminder #Forgiveness #LetsTellAllah

title: Sometimes the world becomes so loud that you begin to feel small inside your own story.
caption:
Sometimes the world becomes so loud that you begin to feel small inside your own story.

The pressure.
The comparison.
The expectations.

But what if you’re seeing yourself through the world's measure?

Your effort is not unseen.
Your sincerity is not insignificant.
And your return is not small.

Stay with this thought for a moment.
Then come back to your heart.

Follow Taking My Soul Home for more journeys inward.

#MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved #AlAzim #IslamicSpirituality #HeartAwakening #SoulfulIslam

title: ٱلْعَظِيمُ — Al-ʿAẓīm
caption:
ٱلْعَظِيمُ — Al-ʿAẓīm

The Magnificent.

A Name that reminds the heart that there is something infinitely greater than whatever feels overwhelming right now.

When you remember His greatness, your fears don't necessarily disappear.

But their size changes.

The heart expands.
The burden becomes lighter.
And what once felt impossible can begin to find its proper place.

Reflect on Al-ʿAẓīm today. Save this and return to it when the world feels too heavy.

#AlAzim #NamesOfAllah #MercifulShades #IslamicReflection #TmySH

title: What if the part of you that feels fragile is exactly the part you need to bring back to Him?
caption:
What if the part of you that feels fragile is exactly the part you need to bring back to Him?

Ya ʿAẓīm…
Raise what is sincere within us.
Honor what is hidden.
Strengthen what is fragile.

Your return does not need to be perfect.

Just return.

And when you do, remember: even what the world overlooks can carry immense weight with Allah.

Come back to this prayer whenever your heart feels small.

#DuaAndDhikr #AlAzim #IslamicSoulWork #ReturnToAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: I don’t need to compete with another soul’s light.
caption:
I don’t need to compete with another soul’s light.
Their rise does not make mine smaller.

When the heart becomes free from comparison, another person’s blessing can become something beautiful to celebrate.

Sometimes purification means learning to say:
“I’m genuinely happy that you’re shining.”

#PurifiedHeart
#SoulAwakening
#InnerPurification
#SpiritualSelfAwareness
#TakingMySoulHome

title: Jealousy often begins with comparison — Why them? Why not me?
caption:
Jealousy often begins with comparison — Why them? Why not me?

But something changes when the heart becomes clean.

You stop seeing another person’s blessing as something taken from you… and begin seeing their light as something worth celebrating.

The ego compares.
The purified heart rejoices.

#EgoToSoul
#JealousyPurified
#InnerHealingJourney
#SpiritualTransformation
#TakingMySoulHome

title: I used to see their success as proof that I was falling behind.
caption:
I used to see their success as proof that I was falling behind.

Their light made me uncomfortable.
Their blessing felt like something I had lost.

But maybe the real wound was never them.

Maybe I was measuring my worth against someone else’s journey.

And now… I’m learning to celebrate what once made me compare.

#EgoAwareness
#HealingComparison
#ShadowWorkJourney
#EmotionalAwareness
#TwoVoicesInsideYou
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: A heart can be surrounded by everything
caption:
A heart can be surrounded by everything
and still feel empty.

And sometimes, a quiet moment of dhikr is enough to bring it back to life.

The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ gave us a profound image: the one who remembers his Lord is like the living, while the one who does not is like the dead.

So let this Friday be more than a greeting.

Let it be a remembrance.

Let Allah Hu pass from the tongue into the heart —
and from the heart into the way we live.

Jummah Mubarak.

#Dhikrullah #AllahHu #JummahMubarak #Sunnah #IslamicReminder

title: A simple invocation, repeated until the noise within begins to soften.
caption:
A simple invocation, repeated until the noise within begins to soften.

This Friday, pause for a moment.

Breathe.
Remember.
Let the heart turn toward its Lord.

May this dhikr bring stillness to our hearts, sincerity to our worship, and light to our path.

Jummah Mubarak.

#AllahHu #Dhikr #JummahMubarak #FridayReminder #IslamicSpirituality

title: There are moments when the heart does not need more words.
caption:
There are moments when the heart does not need more words.

It simply needs to remember Allah.

The Qur’an reminds us that true comfort is found in His remembrance — not because life suddenly becomes effortless, but because the heart remembers Who is near.

This Friday, let your dhikr be more than repetition.
Let it become a return.

A return to stillness.
A return to faith.
A return to Allah.

Jummah Mubarak. 🤍

#JummahMubarak #Dhikr #QuranReminder #IslamicReminder #RememberAllah

title: There are moments when faith asks us to release what our hearts are desperate to hold.
caption:
There are moments when faith asks us to release what our hearts are desperate to hold.

Not because we stop loving.
Not because we stop fearing.

But because we trust Allah more than we trust our own understanding.

The mother of Musa (AS) placed what she loved into the river — and placed what she could not control into the care of her Rabb.

May our fear, too, return to trust.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #TrustAllah #Tawakkul #IslamicReflection

title: A Breath of Return — Episode 22
caption:
A Breath of Return — Episode 22

A mother.
A baby.
A river.

And a promise from Allah.

She could not see where the river would carry what she loved.

But Allah already knew the shore.
Her trembling became trust.

Her letting go became protection.

And what felt like heartbreak became a reunion written by His mercy.

Perhaps this is what surrender asks of us too:

to let go while still holding on to Allah.
To release our fears into His care.

To trust His promise when we cannot see the path.

To believe that what we surrender for His sake is never beyond His mercy.

Take our souls Home to the reunion You wrote for her —

the reunion that comes only from You.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #MusaAS #Tawakkul #TrustInAllah

title: Sometimes we release something with tears in our eyes because we cannot see what comes next.
caption:
Sometimes we release something with tears in our eyes because we cannot see what comes next.

But Allah sees what we cannot.

The story of Musa’s mother reminds us that surrender is not the absence of love.
It is love placed in the hands of the One who knows its destination.

What feels like a goodbye may become a reunion.

What feels like loss may become protection.

What feels impossible may already be moving toward a mercy we cannot yet see.

Trust the One who sees the whole story.
May our surrender return to faith, and our fear return to hope.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #SurrenderToAllah #HopeInAllah #Tawakkul

title: We often ask Allah for more…
caption:
We often ask Allah for more…

More peace.
More success.
More happiness.
More answers.

But sometimes the heart needs something different:

the ability to notice what Allah has already given.

Your breath is a blessing.
A safe home is a blessing.
Someone checking on you is a blessing.
A quiet morning is a blessing.

And sometimes the greatest shift isn't receiving something new—

it's finally seeing what was already there.

What is one blessing you noticed today? 🤍

#IslamicReminder #MuslimReminder #GratefulHeart #DailyReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Not every conversation with Allah begins with pain.
caption:
Not every conversation with Allah begins with pain.

Sometimes it begins with a quiet realization:

“I feel blessed today.”

No dramatic event.
No unanswered crisis.
No request for something more.

Just a heart that finally stopped long enough to notice.

The breath.
The calm.
The morning light.
The softness in the heart.

And then came the reminder:

﴿ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ﴾

“If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.”
— Qur'an 14:7

Maybe gratitude isn't simply saying Alhamdulillah.

Maybe it's learning to see the blessings you've been walking past every day.

Episode 16 — A Moment of Gratitude.

🎬 Let's Tell Allah

#GratitudeToAllah #Shukr #IslamicContent #LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: Gratitude changes more than the words we say.
caption:
Gratitude changes more than the words we say.

It changes what we notice.

You begin to see blessings in ordinary mornings.
Peace in a quiet moment.
Mercy in what you once overlooked.

And your heart begins to understand that “Alhamdulillah” isn't only a response to something good that happened.

It can be a way of seeing life.

A way of recognizing Allah's gifts.

A way of keeping the heart close to Him.

Gratitude is a door.
Open it.

#Alhamdulillah #Gratitude #IslamicQuotes #Reminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Anger can arrive before wisdom does.
caption:
Anger can arrive before wisdom does.

A word stings.
The ego rises.
The heart wants to answer.

But what if the pause is where your strength begins?

Al-Ḥalīm teaches us not every reaction deserves a voice.

Sometimes, staying still is the way we protect the heart.

Stay with this.
Come back to it when you feel provoked.

#AlHalim #IslamicSpirituality #Tazkiyah #SoulfulIslam #MercifulShades

title: ٱلْحَلِيمُ
caption:
ٱلْحَلِيمُ

The One who does not rush to punish.
The One who gives space for hearts to return.

There is something deeply healing in remembering that Divine forbearance is not weakness.

It is restraint.
It is wisdom.
It is room to come back.

And perhaps we are being invited to carry a little more of that gentleness into the world.

Reflect on Al-Ḥalīm today.
Follow and journey with us toward the Beloved.

#AlHalim #NamesOfAllah #IslamicReflection #SpiritualAwakening #TakingMySoulHome

title: Ya Ḥalīm…
caption:
Ya Ḥalīm…

When anger rises, make the heart slower than the tongue.

When we are provoked, give us the strength to remain gentle.

Let our silence become worship.
Let our calm become protection.
Let our hearts soften enough to soften the world around us.

Ameen yā Rabb al-‘Ālamīn.

If this prayer speaks to something within you, save it and come back to it when you need stillness.

#DuaAndDhikr #AlHalim #IslamicMindfulness #HeartSoftening #TmySH

title: You do not become smaller when you bow before your Lord.
caption:
You do not become smaller when you bow before your Lord.
You simply stop carrying the weight of proving yourself.

When pride loosens its grip, something quieter begins to rise — the part of you that was always true.

Sometimes surrender is not losing yourself.
It is finally returning to yourself.

#SoulVsEgo #SpiritualHumility #InnerTransformation #ReturnToTheSoul #TakingMySoulHome

title: The Ego once believed that honor meant standing above everything.
caption:
The Ego once believed that honor meant standing above everything.

Then something changed.

It discovered that bowing willingly does not erase you. It strips away what was never truly yours — the need to be seen, praised, superior, or in control.

And when pride finally lowers itself before its Lord, what remains can rise.

#TwoVoicesInsideYou #PridePurified #EgoToSoul #SpiritualPsychology #TakingMySoulHome
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: I thought I needed to stand taller than everyone else to matter.
caption:
I thought I needed to stand taller than everyone else to matter.

I thought being above others made me worthy.

But I'm tired of carrying that crown.

For once, I bowed willingly.

And strangely… I didn't feel smaller.

I felt free.

#EgoAwareness #PrideAndHumility #InnerHealingJourney #EgoTransformation #TwoVoicesInsideMe

title: There are moments when the heart needs no explanation—
caption:
There are moments when the heart needs no explanation—
only remembrance.

Dhikr brings the heart back to where it belongs: to Allah.

As we repeat Allah Hu, may our hearts become softer, our intentions purer, and our lives more conscious of the One we remember.

This Jummah, let your tongue remember Allah until your heart remembers Him too.

#Dhikr #Zikrullah #IslamicReminder #JummahMubarak #Faith

title: Jummah Mubarak.
caption:
Jummah Mubarak.

May this Friday bring you back to remembrance—
back to stillness,
back to gratitude,
back to Allah.

Let the dhikr play softly.
Let the heart listen deeply.

اللّٰہ ہو… اللّٰہ ہو…

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #Dhikr #IslamicReminder #Spirituality

title: Perhaps the most beautiful part of dhikr is not only that we remember Allah—
caption:
Perhaps the most beautiful part of dhikr is not only that we remember Allah—

but that Allah tells us:

“I will remember you.”

In every quiet repetition, every sincere breath, every moment the heart turns toward Him, there is an invitation to draw nearer.

This Jummah, may our remembrance be more than words on the tongue.

May it become a state of the heart.

#QuranReminder #DhikrAllah #JummahMubarak #Deen #IslamicReminder

title: Some storms are not meant to break us.
caption:
Some storms are not meant to break us.

They are meant to teach us how to keep walking when we cannot yet see the shore.

Nuh (AS) reminds us that patience is not the absence of fear.
It is continuing to trust Allah while the storm is still gathering.

A Breath of Return — Episode 21
Nuh & The Ark of Patience

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #NuhAS #Sabr #TrustAllah

title: Ya Rabb…
caption:
Ya Rabb…

When the storm rises, teach us to build with patience.

When people mock what we are trusting You for, keep our hearts steady.

When the path ahead disappears beneath the waves, remind us that Your mercy can open a way where we see none.

Nuh (AS) teaches us that patience can outlast the flood — and that every storm ends where You decree.

Take our souls Home to the shore You guided him to —
the shore that comes only from You.

A Breath of Return — Episode 21

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #NuhAS #ArkOfPatience #TrustInAllah

title: There is a shore beyond every storm.
caption:
There is a shore beyond every storm.

Not because every storm is easy,
but because Allah decides where the storm ends.

The lesson of Nuh (AS) is not simply about surviving the flood.

It is about trusting the One who knows exactly where the shore is.

May our fear return to trust.
May our patience return to endurance.
And may every storm in our lives become a bridge back to Him.

A Breath of Return — Episode 21

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #NuhAS #MercyOfAllah #Sabr

title: We often think our good deeds have to be extraordinary to matter.
caption:
We often think our good deeds have to be extraordinary to matter.

But sometimes, it is simply giving warmth to someone who is cold.
Helping someone who is struggling.
Offering kindness when you could have walked past.

The deed may feel small to you.

But sincerity gives it meaning.

You may never know how deeply one simple act touched another person’s life.

So keep doing good.
Even when nobody applauds.

Because every sincere act of kindness matters.

#IslamicReminder #GoodDeeds #Kindness #Sincerity #TakingMySoulHome

title: He only gave his jacket.
caption:
He only gave his jacket.

No audience.
No recognition.
No expectation of anything in return.

Just a person who was cold…
and another person who chose to help.

And in that quiet moment, he turned to Allah:

“Ya Allah… please accept this small deed from me.”

Perhaps that is the beauty of sincerity.

We may see the deed as small.

But Allah sees what is in the heart.

﴾ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ ﴿

“Allah never lets the reward of those who do good be lost.”
— Qur’an 9:120

Do the good you can.

Give what you can.

Help where you can.

And leave the acceptance with Allah.

#LetsTellAllah #IslamicReminder #GoodDeeds #Sincerity #QuranReminder

title: Maybe you helped someone once and never thought about it again.
caption:
Maybe you helped someone once and never thought about it again.

Maybe you gave something away.
Maybe you made someone's difficult moment a little easier.
Maybe you chose kindness when you could have chosen indifference.

And maybe, afterward, you thought:

“It was nothing.”

But don't be so quick to dismiss the good you do.

The message of the Qur'an is deeply reassuring:

“Allah never lets the reward of those who do good be lost.”
— Qur’an 9:120

So don't measure your good deeds only by their size.

Do what you can.

Do it sincerely.

And trust Allah with the rest.

#QuranReminder #AllahIsAware #GoodDeeds #IslamicQuotes #MuslimReminder

title: Sometimes the hardest part is carrying something no one else can see.
caption:
Sometimes the hardest part is carrying something no one else can see.

The silence.
The struggle.
The fear behind the calm.

But Al-Khabīr knows what remains unseen.

He knows the truth behind your silence, the sincerity behind your struggle, and the strength you have not yet discovered within yourself.

You’re not unseen.

Stay with this thought.
And if your heart needed these words today, save them and come back to them.

#AlKhabir #NamesOfAllah #IslamicSpirituality #SoulfulReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: People may only see where you are.
caption:
People may only see where you are.

Allah knows what brought you there.

He knows the heart beneath the circumstance, the intention beneath the action, and the hidden strength beneath the uncertainty.

Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه was entrusted with a moment others may not have been able to carry.

Perhaps there are moments in your own life that feel beyond you.

What if Allah knows your capacity more completely than you do?

Reflect on that today.

#AlKhabir #AsmaUlHusna #IslamicReflection #SpiritualAwakening #MercifulShades

title: Yā Khabīr…
caption:
Yā Khabīr…

Guide us through what we cannot see.

There are paths we understand only after we have walked them.

There are delays whose wisdom appears later.

There are moments when the heart cannot see the way forward — yet Allah's knowledge is never limited by what we can see.

So perhaps today, we do not need every answer.

Perhaps we simply need to return, soften, and trust the One who already knows.

Come back to this prayer whenever the unseen feels heavy.

#YaKhabir #DuaAndDhikr #IslamicSoulJourney #DivineNames #MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved

title: Not every desire needs to be silenced. Some desires simply need to be purified.
caption:
Not every desire needs to be silenced. Some desires simply need to be purified.

When the heart stops chasing what only dazzles the eyes and begins seeking what brings it closer to truth, longing changes. It becomes quieter. More intentional. More sincere.

What once pulled you outward can become a prayer that turns you inward.

Sometimes the heart doesn’t need less desire.
It needs a truer direction.

#DesirePurified #SoulVsEgo #SpiritualIntention #InnerTransformation #TakingMySoulHome

title: Desire is not always the problem.
caption:
Desire is not always the problem.
Sometimes, it is simply pointing in the wrong direction.

The Ego reaches for what shines. The Soul asks what brings you closer.

And when longing is no longer about possession, validation, or escape—when it aligns with truth—it becomes something deeper.

A prayer.

Episode 21 explores the quiet transformation of desire: from something that pulls you outward into something that draws your heart closer.

#DesireAndFaith #SoulVsEgoSeries #SpiritualAwakening #HeartTransformation #TakingMySoulHome
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: I used to want everything that glittered.
caption:
I used to want everything that glittered.

More.
Faster.
Closer.
Now I’m beginning to ask a different question:

Where does this desire take me?

Maybe I don’t need to kill every longing inside me. Maybe I need to stop feeding the ones that leave me emptier.

I want only what brings me closer.

And for the first time, that feels like enough.

#EgoAwareness #HealingDesire #InnerWorkJourney #SoulAndEgo #SpiritualSelfAwareness

title: Sometimes we ask Allah for greater doors—
caption:
Sometimes we ask Allah for greater doors—
but forget to ask Him for the heart that can carry what lies beyond them.

May Allah give us strength without arrogance,
capability without pride,
and opportunities without letting them pull us away from Him.

Because every gift is an amanah.

This Jummah Mubarak, may our Friday Prayer remind us that true strength is not merely what we are capable of doing—it is what we remain sincere enough to do for His sake.

May Allah make our abilities a means of goodness, our opportunities a path toward Him, and our success something that brings us closer to our Deen.

Ameen.

#JummahMubarak #IslamicReminder #FridayPrayer #Faith #Amanah

title: Jummah Mubarak. 🤍
caption:
Jummah Mubarak. 🤍

May Allah bless you with what your heart needs,
and give you the wisdom to carry what He places in your hands.

May every blessing become a doorway to goodness,
and every Dua a step closer to Him.

A peaceful Friday.
A sincere heart.
A life that keeps returning to Allah.

#JummahMubarak #FridayBlessings #Dua #IslamicReminder #Spirituality

title: What Allah places in your hands is never merely yours.
caption:
What Allah places in your hands is never merely yours.

Your ability.
Your influence.
Your wealth.
Your opportunities.
Even the doors that open unexpectedly.

They are trusts.

The real test is not only whether Allah gives—
but what we become after He gives.

May our blessings never become distractions from our Deen.
May our success never make us forget the One who gave it.
And may every responsibility entrusted to us be carried with sincerity, justice, mercy, and truth.

This Friday, may our Dua be simple:

Ya Rabb, give me what I can carry—
and make me worthy of what You give.

Ameen yā Rabb al-‘Ālamīn.

#JummahMubarak #IslamicReminder #Sincerity #Deen #Faith

title: What if the greatest thing that could ever be said about us is not something heard on earth—but something spoken in the heavens?
caption:
What if the greatest thing that could ever be said about us is not something heard on earth—but something spoken in the heavens?

Not our achievements.
Not our status.
Not how loudly the world knows our name.

But that our quiet efforts, sincere intentions, and hidden acts of goodness have drawn us closer to the love of Allah.

Perhaps the soul's deepest longing has always been this:

to be loved by the One it was created to return to.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #DivineLove #IslamicReflection #ReturnToAllah

title: There is an honor greater than being known by the world.
caption:
There is an honor greater than being known by the world.

To be loved by Allah.

This breath remembers the profound meaning of being among those whose sincerity, quiet deeds, and hidden intentions become worthy of divine love.

A love that changes how we live.
A love that changes what we seek.
A love that brings the soul closer to its true Home.

May our lives return to what draws His love, our breaths to what pleases Him, and our hearts to the nearness He gives to those He loves.

A Breath of Return — Episode 20: The Announcement in the Heavens.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #AllahsLove #IslamicReminder #ReturnToAllah

title: If being loved by Allah is the greatest honor, then perhaps our lives should quietly move toward what earns that love.
caption:
If being loved by Allah is the greatest honor, then perhaps our lives should quietly move toward what earns that love.

A sincere intention.
A hidden good deed.
A breath taken in remembrance.
A kindness no one sees.
A choice made only because it pleases Him.

We do not need the world to announce our names.

We only need our lives to become a little more sincere, a little more gentle, and a little more pleasing to the One we hope to return to.

May our smallest acts carry the greatest sincerity.

#ABreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #SincereDeeds #IslamicReflection #CloserToAllah

title: What if you're not actually falling behind?
caption:
What if you're not actually falling behind?

Maybe you're comparing your life to timelines that were never written for you.

Someone else is getting married.
Someone else is building a career.
Someone else is buying a home.
Someone else seems to have “figured it all out.”

And quietly, you start wondering:

“What am I doing with my life?”

But not every delay is failure.
Not every different path is a wrong path.
And not every season of waiting means you've been forgotten.

Sometimes the better question isn't:

“Why am I behind?”

It's:

“Where is my heart going?”

Because a meaningful life isn't measured only by how much you accomplish.

It's also measured by how close you become to Allah.

Stop measuring your life only by the world's clock.

#IslamicReminder #MuslimReminder #PurposeOfLife #SpiritualJourney #TrustAllah

title: There are moments when life looks completely normal from the outside…
caption:
There are moments when life looks completely normal from the outside…

You're grateful.
You're trying.
You're moving through your days.

Yet somewhere inside, a quiet question remains:

“What is the purpose of my life?”

Not How can I become more successful?
Not How can I have more?
Not How can I be ahead of everyone else?

But:

“What did You create me to do?”

Sometimes the most important questions are the ones we finally become quiet enough to ask Allah.

And sometimes the answer isn't as complicated as we imagined.

Episode 14 — Falling Behind
Let’s Tell Allah.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #PurposeOfLife #IslamicReminder #QuranReminder

title: Take a moment before you answer this.
caption:
Take a moment before you answer this.

If everything you're currently chasing disappeared tomorrow — your title, your income, your achievements, your plans, your status — what would still make your life meaningful?

The Qur'an gives us a profound answer:

ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ

˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving.

— Al-Mulk - 67:2

Worship isn't meant to make life smaller.

It gives life its direction.

To know Allah.
To walk toward Him.
To let your life become a reflection of that closeness.

Maybe your purpose was never as far away as you thought.

Maybe you've simply been looking for it in places that were never meant to hold it.

What would your answer be?

#QuranReminder #PurposeOfLife #IslamicReminder #WorshipAllah #MuslimReflection

title: What if the thing you fear is already being carried by a mercy you cannot yet see?
caption:
What if the thing you fear is already being carried by a mercy you cannot yet see?

Musa’s mother knew what it meant to release what she loved into uncertainty. The river looked like danger. The basket looked fragile. The future looked impossible.

But Al-Laṭīf was already moving through every detail.

Sometimes protection does not arrive loudly. Sometimes it looks like delay, redirection, silence, or surrender.

Stay with this.

What in your life might be held more gently than you realize?

#AlLatif #IslamicReflection #NamesOfAllah #TawakkulJourney #TakingMySoulHome

title: ٱللَّطِيفُ — Al-Laṭīf
caption:
ٱللَّطِيفُ — Al-Laṭīf

The One whose gentleness moves through what we cannot see.

A river becomes protection.
A palace becomes refuge.
A separation becomes reunion.

The story of Musa عليه السلام reminds us that Divine care is often hidden inside the smallest details.

Not every mercy announces itself.

Some mercies arrive quietly enough that we only recognize them later.

Come back to this Name when your path feels uncertain.

#MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved #AlLatif #AsmaUlHusna #IslamicSpirituality #KnowAllah

title: Yā Laṭīf…
caption:
Yā Laṭīf…

Carry us through the rivers we fear.

Return us to the places that heal us.

Soften what has hardened inside us, and let Your hidden kindness reach the parts of our story we do not yet understand.

Perhaps the delay is protection.
Perhaps the meeting is redirection.
Perhaps the softness arriving now is exactly what keeps the heart from breaking.

Save this prayer. Return to it when life feels uncertain.

#DailyDua #YaLatif #HeartHealing #SpiritualReturn #IslamicReminder

title: You were never meant to exhaust yourself trying to outrun everyone else. The Soul does not measure its worth by being ahead. It remembers where it is going. Slow down. Walk with intention. What is written for you will not require you to become someone else to reach it. There is no race when the destination is return.
caption:
You were never meant to exhaust yourself trying to outrun everyone else. The Soul does not measure its worth by being ahead. It remembers where it is going. Slow down. Walk with intention. What is written for you will not require you to become someone else to reach it. There is no race when the destination is return.

#SoulVsEgo #SpiritualReturn #InnerPeaceJourney #SelfAwarenessJourney #TakingMySoulHome

title: The Ego keeps score. Who is ahead? Who has more? Who won?
caption:
The Ego keeps score. Who is ahead? Who has more? Who won?
But eventually, the race becomes exhausting.

Episode 20 is about the moment you realize that not every path is a competition. You can stop chasing another person’s life and begin walking toward your own return.

Maybe peace begins when the need to win disappears.

#CompetitionDissolves #SoulVsEgoSeries #InnerTransformation #SpiritualAwakening #TakingMySoulHome
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: I thought winning would finally make me feel enough.
caption:
I thought winning would finally make me feel enough.
So I kept running. Comparing. Proving. Chasing.

But every finish line created another one.

Maybe I’m not weak for being tired. Maybe I’m tired because I was never meant to race everyone else. Maybe the hardest competition was the one happening inside me.

#EgoAwareness #HealingTheEgo #StopComparing #InnerVoice #SoulVsEgo

title: Some blessings arrive carrying weight.
caption:
Some blessings arrive carrying weight.

A capability.
An opportunity.
A responsibility.
A door you once prayed would open.

This Friday Prayer, ask not only to be given more—but to become someone who can carry what Allah entrusts.

Strength without sincerity can mislead.
Ability without trust can corrupt.

May every gift placed in our hands become a path to goodness, service, and deeper faith.

Jummah Mubarak. May Allah make us strong enough to carry our blessings, and sincere enough to return every success to Him.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #Faith #Deen

title: A blessing is not only something we receive.
caption:
A blessing is not only something we receive.

Sometimes, it is a test of what remains in the heart after receiving it.

May this blessed Friday fill our lives with gifts that do not distract us from Allah—but draw us nearer, clearer, and truer.

Jummah Mubarak.

#JummahMubarak #Dua #Spirituality #IslamicReminder #Faith

title: We often ask Allah to expand what is in our hands.
caption:
We often ask Allah to expand what is in our hands.

More ability.
More opportunity.
More influence.
More blessing.

But perhaps the deeper prayer is this:

Ya Rabb, purify the reason I want it.

Because the same gift can become pride—or service.
The same opportunity can become distraction—or worship.

May our intentions remain sincere when doors open, when blessings grow, and when people begin to notice what Allah has given us.

May every capability become a means of goodness.

#FridayPrayer #Sincerity #IslamicReminder #Dua #Spirituality

title: Some moments feel final.
caption:
Some moments feel final.

A mistake. A loss. A closed door. A future we fear has already been written.

But the story of the people of Yunus (AS) reminds us that when hearts truly return, mercy can meet them in places where they expected punishment.

Perhaps what feels final is only waiting for your return.

#Future #HazratYunus #Heart #Mercy #TmySH

title: In this breath, we remember how Allah lifted punishment from the people of Yunus (AS) when their hearts returned to Him.
caption:
In this breath, we remember how Allah lifted punishment from the people of Yunus (AS) when their hearts returned to Him.

Their story reminds us that nothing is final when a heart turns back.

That mercy can meet us where we expected consequences.

That repentance can open doors we thought were closed.

And that a whispered duʿā can carry more hope than we can see.

May our hearts return to the One whose mercy can rewrite everything.

#ProphetYunus #Story #Mercy #Whisper #Hope TakingMySoulHome

title: We do not always know what tomorrow holds.
caption:
We do not always know what tomorrow holds.

But we know Who holds tomorrow.

So we return.

With our mistakes.
With our fears.
With the stories we thought could never change.

May our whispered prayers rise with sincerity, our repentance open doors we thought were closed, and our hearts never lose hope in the mercy of Allah.

Because His compassion is greater than our mistakes.

#Allah #Mistakes #Fears #Stories #TakingMySoulHome

title: How much of your peace have you already given to a tomorrow that hasn’t even arrived?
caption:
How much of your peace have you already given to a tomorrow that hasn’t even arrived?

We replay conversations that haven’t happened.
We imagine failures that don’t exist yet.
We prepare for disasters that may never come.

And somewhere between all those “what ifs,” we forget to live the day Allah has already placed in our hands.

Maybe the future isn’t asking you to solve everything tonight.

Maybe today is simply asking you to breathe… take the next step… and let tomorrow arrive when it arrives.

You don’t have to carry every possible future at once.

Come back to today. That is where your life is happening.

#MentalPeace #IslamicReminder #Mindfulness #TrustAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: What if I fail?
caption:
What if I fail?

What if things go wrong?

What if tomorrow brings more than I can handle?

Sometimes the future feels heavier than the present. Deadlines, decisions, responsibilities, and endless “what ifs” can turn tomorrow into a storm before it has even arrived.

But what if the unknown isn’t unknown to Allah?

What if the future you fear is already within the knowledge of the One who knows every step before you take it?

Tonight, when tomorrow feels too heavy, pause.

Look up.

And tell Allah what you’re afraid of.

Let’s Tell Allah — Episode 13: Fear of Tomorrow.

 وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ 

“Whoever relies upon Allah — He is enough for them.”
— Qur’an 65:3

#FearOfTomorrow #TrustAllah #FearAndFaith #LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: The future scares us because we cannot see it.
caption:
The future scares us because we cannot see it.

We don’t know which door will open.
Which plan will fail.
Which prayer will be answered differently than we expected.
Or what tomorrow will ask from us.

But there is something your fear forgets:

Tomorrow is unknown to you. It is not unknown to Allah.

The path may be hidden from your eyes, but it has never been hidden from Him.

So perhaps you were never meant to know everything before taking the next step.

Perhaps trust begins exactly where certainty ends.

﴾ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ﴿

“Whoever relies upon Allah — He is enough for them.”
— Qur’an 65:3

#Tawakkul #TrustAllah #FearOfTheFuture #IslamicQuotes #TmySH

title: Rabi’ al-Awwal arrives with an invitation to pause, reflect, and remember a life that continues to guide millions of hearts. ﷺ
caption:
Rabi’ al-Awwal arrives with an invitation to pause, reflect, and remember a life that continues to guide millions of hearts. ﷺ

May this blessed month bring us closer to the values of mercy, compassion, patience, and love that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ embodied throughout his life.

Perhaps the most beautiful way to honour a legacy is not only to remember it, but to let it transform the way we live.

#RabialAwwal #IslamicReminder #MuslimUmmah #ProphetMuhammad #IslamicInspiration

title: رَبِيعُ الأَوَّل
caption:
رَبِيعُ الأَوَّل

A month that calls the heart back to reflection.

Back to the Seerah.
Back to mercy.
Back to compassion.
Back to the example of the one whose life was a guide for humanity. ﷺ

This Rabi’ al-Awwal, don’t let remembrance remain only in words.

Read his story.
Learn his character.
Send blessings upon him.
And carry a little more mercy into the world.

Let his example bring your soul closer to home.

#RabialAwwal1448 #Seerah #ProphetMuhammadﷺ #IslamicContent #MuslimCommunity

title: To the Muslim Ummah, may this Rabi’ al-Awwal be a month of deeper reflection, softer hearts, and more beautiful character.
caption:
To the Muslim Ummah, may this Rabi’ al-Awwal be a month of deeper reflection, softer hearts, and more beautiful character.

May we remember that love for the Prophet ﷺ is not only spoken—it is reflected in mercy, kindness, honesty, patience, and the way we treat one another.

May his example inspire us to become gentler souls in a world that desperately needs compassion.

Rabi’ al-Awwal Mubarak.

#MuslimUmmah #RabiulAwwal #Sunnah #IslamicMotivation #FaithAndReflection

title: When something inside us slips, we often try to hide the imbalance.
caption:
When something inside us slips, we often try to hide the imbalance.

But the heart knows.

A quiet weight settles.
An ache rises.
Something no longer feels aligned.

What if that discomfort is not rejection?

What if it is guidance?

Al-‘Adl reminds us that even our inner imbalance can become a doorway back. Not through shame, but through honesty. Not through being crushed, but through returning.

Stay with this.

What has your heart been trying to realign?

#AlAdl #IslamicReflection #TazkiyahJourney #ReturnToAllah #SoulAwakening

title: Al-‘Adl — The Utterly Just.
caption:
Al-‘Adl — The Utterly Just.

His justice is not separate from His mercy.

He sees the weakness behind the mistake.
The intention behind the action.
The regret behind the silence.
The longing beneath the return.

You are not only the moment you slipped.

And when you turn back, the path is not closed.

Guilt can become guidance.
Repentance can become medicine.
Forgiveness can become balance.

Come back to this when your heart feels unseen by the world.

Follow Taking My Soul Home as we journey deeper into the Names of the Beloved.

#MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved #NamesOfAllah #IslamicSpirituality #HeartHealing #KnowAllah

title: There is a kind of justice that restores.
caption:
There is a kind of justice that restores.

A justice that does not leave you trapped inside your worst moment.

Yā ‘Adl…

Straighten what has bent within us.

When we lose balance, realign us.
When our intentions become unclear, purify them.
When the path feels tilted, bring us back.

And perhaps when one heart returns to balance, something beyond that heart changes too.

A little more honesty.
A little more fairness.
A little more peace.

Individual consciousness can shape collective consciousness.

Reflect on this. Then return to the One who knows exactly where your heart belongs.

#DuaForTheHeart #InnerAlignment #IslamicMindfulness #SpiritualReturn #HealingThroughFaith

title: Breathe.
caption:
Breathe.
You don’t have to force the awakening.

The fog does not disappear all at once. First, you notice a little more light. Then you become aware of the thoughts that once controlled you. Then, quietly, you begin to remember who you are beneath the noise.

Awareness is returning. Stay humble. Stay still. Keep remembering.

#TakingMySoulHome #SoulAwakening #SpiritualAwareness #InnerHealingJourney #ReturnToYourself

title: What happens when the voice inside you finally wakes up?
caption:
What happens when the voice inside you finally wakes up?

For so long, the fog can feel normal. Distraction becomes comfort. Noise becomes identity. Forgetfulness becomes a way of living.

But then something shifts.

You pause. You breathe. You notice.

And suddenly, the fog begins to thin.

Episode 19 — Heedlessness Lifts
A conversation between the part of you that was lost in the noise… and the part that never stopped calling you back.

#SoulVsEgo #ImWakingUp #SpiritualSelfAwareness #InnerTransformation #TakingMySoulHome

title: I thought the fog was protecting me.
caption:
I thought the fog was protecting me.

Maybe I stayed distracted because silence would have made me face myself. Maybe I kept moving because stopping would have made me feel everything.

But now something is changing.

The fog is thinning.

And for the first time, I’m beginning to see what I was avoiding.

Maybe waking up is not loud.

Maybe it begins with one quiet breath.

#EgoAwakening #BreakTheFog #SelfAwarenessJourney #EmotionalHealing #SoulVsEgo

title: Forgiveness is not always easy.
caption:
Forgiveness is not always easy.

Sometimes pride wants the final word.
Pain wants to be remembered.
And the heart wants proof
that what happened mattered.

But mercy asks something deeper of us.

Not to pretend the wound never existed—
but to refuse to let it become our identity.

To forgive others.
To forgive ourselves.
To choose peace without denying the truth.

This Friday, ask Allah to make mercy more than an occasional act.

Make it your instinct.

May compassion become the way you speak,
the way you judge,
and the way you walk through this world.

And may every act of forgiveness bring you closer to The Most Forgiving.

#IslamicReminder #Forgiveness #Mercy #Deen #JummahMubarak

title: Some Fridays arrive like a gentle hand
caption:
Some Fridays arrive like a gentle hand
placed upon the heart.

A reminder to release what hurts.

To forgive what still aches.

To return to Allah
without rehearsing every mistake first.

May this Jummah bring peace where pride once lived,
mercy where pain remained,
and the courage to let go of what your soul was never meant to carry forever.

Jummah Mubarak.

May your dua be heard,
your heart be softened,
and your return be welcomed with mercy.

#JummahMubarak #FridayBlessings #Dua #Faith #Spirituality

title: Sometimes the hardest person to forgive
caption:
Sometimes the hardest person to forgive
is the one we meet in the mirror.

We carry old mistakes like evidence against ourselves.
We hesitate to return.
We mistake shame for humility
and distance for punishment.

But Allah leaves the door open.

This Friday Prayer is for every heart
that is tired of running from its past.

Return.

Not because you have become perfect,
but because He is Al-Ghafur —
the Most Forgiving.

Your Deen was never built on never falling.
It was built on knowing where to return when you do.

May this Islamic Reminder soften the weight you carry and remind you: Allah’s mercy is still greater than your mistakes.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #QuranReminder #AllahsMercy #IslamicReminder

title: Sometimes the heart we fear most is the heart we have not yet seen transformed. Umar’s story reminds us that intensity can become clarity, strength can become justice, and even a heart once consumed by fire can be turned toward faith. No story is too far for Allah’s mercy to rewrite.
caption:
Sometimes the heart we fear most is the heart we have not yet seen transformed. Umar’s story reminds us that intensity can become clarity, strength can become justice, and even a heart once consumed by fire can be turned toward faith. No story is too far for Allah’s mercy to rewrite.

#ReturnToLight #HeartTransformation #IslamicReflection #FaithJourney #SpiritualGrowth

title: In this breath, we remember Umar (RA) — a heart once set on anger, transformed by Allah into strength, clarity, justice, and faith. His story reminds us that transformation does not begin with perfection. It begins when the heart turns. May our fire return to light, our impulses return to wisdom, and our hearts return to the transformation only Allah can write.
caption:
In this breath, we remember Umar (RA) — a heart once set on anger, transformed by Allah into strength, clarity, justice, and faith. His story reminds us that transformation does not begin with perfection. It begins when the heart turns. May our fire return to light, our impulses return to wisdom, and our hearts return to the transformation only Allah can write.

#ABreathOfReturn #UmarRA #HeartThatTurned #IslamicReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Perhaps the fire within us was never meant to destroy us. Perhaps it was meant to be transformed. May the anger within us become clarity, our impulses become wisdom, and our strength become something that serves what is right. May our hearts return to the light Allah intended for them.
caption:
Perhaps the fire within us was never meant to destroy us. Perhaps it was meant to be transformed. May the anger within us become clarity, our impulses become wisdom, and our strength become something that serves what is right. May our hearts return to the light Allah intended for them.

#IslamicContent #MuslimInspiration #DailyReminder #PathToAllah #DeenOverDunya

title: Sometimes loneliness has nothing to do with being physically alone.
caption:
Sometimes loneliness has nothing to do with being physically alone.

You can sit in a crowded room, laugh at the right moments, answer every question… and still feel like no one truly sees what is happening inside you.

That kind of loneliness is different.

It is not always asking for more people.

Sometimes, it is asking for one place where your heart does not have to pretend.

If you have ever felt alone while surrounded by everyone, you are not strange for feeling that way. Your heart may simply be searching for a connection deeper than conversation.

#Loneliness #FeelingAlone #EmotionalLoneliness #MentalHealthAwareness #TakingMySoulHome

title: What do you do when the room is full…
caption:
What do you do when the room is full…

but your heart still feels empty?

When people are talking around you, laughing around you, living around you…

and somehow, you still feel unseen?

Tonight, don't force yourself to pretend you're okay.

Don't shame yourself for feeling lonely.

Just be honest.

Let's Tell Allah.

Allah… I feel lonely tonight.
There were so many people around me,
but I still felt unseen, unheard, unconnected.

My heart feels empty…

Please… don't let me feel alone.

Episode 12 — WHEN YOU FEEL ALONE INSIDE

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #IslamicReminder #FeelingAlone #Loneliness

title: Some feelings are difficult to explain.
caption:
Some feelings are difficult to explain.

You may not know why your heart feels heavy.

You may not know why being surrounded by people still feels lonely.

You may not even have the words to describe what is happening inside you.

But Allah does not need a perfect explanation to understand your heart.

He hears the words you say.

He hears the prayers you struggle to form.

And He knows the feelings you cannot put into words.

So when you feel unseen, remember:

You are not as unseen as you feel.

There is One who knows every silent ache.

#AllahIsNear #YouAreNotAlone #IslamicReminder #QuranReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Sometimes people meet one moment of our story and decide they know the whole of us.
caption:
Sometimes people meet one moment of our story and decide they know the whole of us.

They see the reaction, but not the wound.
The silence, but not the struggle.
The mistake, but not the intention.

Al-Ḥakam reminds us that Allah sees the entire tapestry.

So before you carry someone else's judgment into your heart, pause.

What if the One who truly knows your story is the only Judge you need?

Stay with this. Reflect on it. And come back whenever the weight of being misunderstood feels heavy.

#AlHakam #NamesOfAllah #IslamicSpirituality #HeartHealing #TakingMySoulHome

title: There is a kind of safety in knowing that your story is not being judged from a fragment.
caption:
There is a kind of safety in knowing that your story is not being judged from a fragment.

Al-Ḥakam knows what came before the moment.
What lived behind the words.
What your heart intended before anyone saw the action.

His judgment is complete because His knowledge is complete.

Perhaps surrender does not mean giving up on justice.

Perhaps it means finally placing your story in the hands of the One who already knows it.

Save this thought. Return to it when you feel unseen.

#AlHakam #99NamesOfAllah #IslamicReflection #SpiritualJourney #MercifulShadesOfTheBeloved

title: What if you no longer had to prove your heart to everyone?
caption:
What if you no longer had to prove your heart to everyone?

Not every misunderstanding needs an explanation.
Not every accusation needs a response.
Not every opinion deserves a place inside you.

There is a deeper place to return to:

Ya Ḥakam.

You know the truth of my story.
You know what I cannot explain.
Let Your justice be enough for my heart.

Take a quiet moment tonight and ask yourself: **Whose judgment am I still carrying?**

Then release it.

#AlHakam #IslamicReminder #Tawakkul #SoulfulIslam #TakingMySoulHome

title: Sometimes the distance we feel from ourselves feels impossible to cross. But the Soul knows something the wounded heart forgets: you were never as far away as you believed. What feels like the end may simply be the moment you stop running from yourself and begin returning. Mercy was closer than the fear that convinced you otherwise.
caption:
Sometimes the distance we feel from ourselves feels impossible to cross. But the Soul knows something the wounded heart forgets: you were never as far away as you believed. What feels like the end may simply be the moment you stop running from yourself and begin returning. Mercy was closer than the fear that convinced you otherwise.

#SoulVsEgo #TakingMySoulHome #MercyIsNear #InnerHealingJourney #SpiritualReturn

title: Despair tells you that you've gone too far, broken too much, and lost the way back. But sometimes the first step toward healing is simply questioning that belief. Episode 18 explores the quiet moment when despair softens—and the heart begins to realize that mercy may have been closer all along.
caption:
Despair tells you that you've gone too far, broken too much, and lost the way back. But sometimes the first step toward healing is simply questioning that belief. Episode 18 explores the quiet moment when despair softens—and the heart begins to realize that mercy may have been closer all along.

#SoulVsEgoSeries #TakingMySoulHome #DespairToHope #SpiritualHealing #InnerTransformation
series: Two Wise Inside: Soul vs. Ego

title: For so long, I believed I was too far gone. That whatever was broken inside me could never be repaired. But then, for the first time, I wondered: what if I’m wrong? Maybe I haven't lost the way back. Maybe I’ve only been standing too far inside my own darkness to see it.
caption:
For so long, I believed I was too far gone. That whatever was broken inside me could never be repaired. But then, for the first time, I wondered: what if I’m wrong? Maybe I haven't lost the way back. Maybe I’ve only been standing too far inside my own darkness to see it.

#EgoVsSoul #DespairSoftens #SelfAwarenessJourney #HealingTheInnerSelf #TakingMySoulHome

title: Perhaps you think
caption:
Perhaps you think
your return is too small.
One prayer.
One sincere tear.
One quiet “forgive me.”
One decision not to give up again.
But the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ taught us something profoundly hopeful:
Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a person who finds their lost provisions after believing they were gone forever.
Sunnah.com
So keep returning.
Even tired.
Even imperfect.
Even with a heart that feels cracked.
Because sincerity does not require perfection.
It only requires that you keep turning back to Allah.
Jummah Mubarak.
May Allah accept every small effort, every quiet attempt, and every trembling step taken toward His mercy.
#Repentance #JummahPrayer #IslamicReminder #Spirituality #Sincerity

title: Sometimes the most beautiful Dua
caption:
Sometimes the most beautiful Dua
is simply:
“Ya Allah, I am back.”
May this Jummah bring peace
to the heart that is trying again.
May Allah forgive what is behind you,
strengthen what is within you,
and bless every step you take toward Him.
Jummah Mubarak.
#Jummah #JummahMubarak #Dua #Deen #FridayBlessings

title: You may have wandered.
caption:
You may have wandered.
You may have made mistakes
you wish you could undo.
But returning to Allah
is never a journey to be ashamed of.
It is a journey of faith.
This Friday Prayer is a quiet reminder:
You do not have to return perfect.
You only have to return sincere.
Bring the tired heart.
Bring the regret.
Bring the small trembling hope
that still reaches toward Allah.
His mercy is greater than the distance you travelled away.
📖 “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.”
— Qur’an 39:53 �
Quran
Jummah Mubarak.
May Allah accept every sincere return, forgive every mistake, and guide our hearts home.
#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #MercyOfAllah #Faith

But their blessing is not evidence of your delay.

Your life is not late.
Your journey is not forgotten.

caption:

caption:

Jealousy isn't always loud.
Sometimes it's hidden behind a smile, a "Congratulations," or another scroll through social media.

The real victory isn't pretending you never feel envy.
It's noticing it before it changes your heart.

Every blessing you see is part of someone else's journey.
Your story is still being written by the One who never makes mistakes.

Instead of asking,
"Why them?"

title: 🧠 Quick Reflection
caption:

True or False?

"If I keep feeling guilty forever, it proves my repentance was sincere."

❌ False.

Sincere repentance isn't measured by endless self-punishment.

It's measured by:

✔ Regret

✔ Turning back to Allah

✔ Leaving the sin

✔ Striving to become better

Allah doesn't invite you back only to keep you trapped in shame.

His mercy restores.

His forgiveness heals.

His love gives hope.

If you've sincerely repented...

perhaps it's time to stop arguing with the mercy Allah has already offered.

title: Not every miracle begins with a mountain moving.
caption:
Not every miracle begins with a mountain moving.

Sometimes it begins with one heart becoming a place of safety for another.

Before certainty reached the world, mercy first found a home.

Episode 14 of A Breath of Return reflects on the quiet strength of Khadija (RA)—a woman whose faith became comfort, whose presence became peace, and whose love became a shelter at the beginning of revelation.

May Allah make us a mercy for those who seek refuge in our presence.

#BreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #TmySH #Mercy #Home

title: Not every miracle begins with a mountain moving.
caption:

Sometimes it begins with one heart becoming a place of safety for another.

Before certainty reached the world, mercy first found a home.

Episode 14 of A Breath of Return reflects on the quiet strength of Khadija (RA)—a woman whose faith became comfort, whose presence became peace, and whose love became a shelter at the beginning of revelation.
