#BreathOfReturn #TakingMySoulHome #TmySH #Mercy #Home

title: Real strength is often quiet.
caption:
Real strength is often quiet.

It comforts before it speaks.

It steadies before it is noticed.

The legacy of Khadija (RA) reminds us that faith is not only what we believe—it is also the peace we bring into another person's life.

May Allah make our homes places of mercy, our words places of comfort, and our hearts places where others remember Him.

Aameen.

#BreathOfReturn #HazratKhadija #Strength #Reminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Who remembers you when the room grows quiet?
caption:
Who remembers you when the room grows quiet?

We spend our lives hoping someone will remember our birthday, our sacrifices, our stories, our presence.

But life becomes busy.

People forget.

Not always because they don't care...
sometimes because they're human.

There is One whose memory never fades.

He remembers every tear.
Every dua.
Every silent heartbreak.
Every year nobody asked how you were.

The greatest comfort isn't being remembered by the world.

It's being remembered by Allah.

Tell us honestly...
What helps you feel remembered?

👇 We'd love to read your thoughts.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #IslamicReminder #Reminder #Muslim

title: Sometimes...
caption:
Sometimes...

The people we love become busy.

Conversations move on.

The room is full...

yet our hearts feel empty.

This episode is for everyone who has ever whispered,

"Does anyone still notice me?"

Tonight, we remember something beautiful.

Even when people become distracted...

Allah never becomes distant.

If your heart has ever felt forgotten,

this episode was made for you.

🎥 Episode 8 of Let's Tell Allah is now live.

May it remind you that the One who created you has never forgotten you—not for a single moment.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #Faith #Hope #Dua

title: One day...
caption:
One day...

your job may end.

Your children may grow up.

Your phone may stop ringing.

People may become busy.

The world may move faster than your heart.

Never mistake people's silence for your worth.

Your value has never depended on how much attention you receive.

It has always rested with the One who created you.

Allah has never forgotten your name.

Never forgotten your prayers.

Never forgotten your story.

And He never will.

❤️ Send this to someone who needs to remember that today.

#LetsTellAllah #TakingMySoulHome #Quran #Allah #Islam

title: The world measures honour by applause, titles, followers, and recognition.
caption:
The world measures honour by applause, titles, followers, and recognition.

Al-Muʿizz teaches something quieter.

True honour begins long before anyone notices it.

It begins when the heart returns to sincerity.

What if the honour you're searching for is already growing where no one can see?

Stay with this. Reflect with us, and follow the journey Home.

#MercifulShades #AlMuizz #JourneyToTheBeloved #IslamicReflection #TakingMySoulHome

title: Ṭālūt wasn't chosen because people admired him.
caption:
Ṭālūt wasn't chosen because people admired him.

Dāwūd wasn't honoured because he looked powerful.

Allah honoured hearts that aligned with Him.

Perhaps honour isn't something we achieve.

Perhaps it's something we receive.

Come back to this whenever the world makes you question your worth.

Follow for more reflections on the Beautiful Names of Allah.

#AsmaulHusna #AlMuizz #SpiritualGrowth #HeartAwakening #TakingMySoulHome

title: Every sincere choice changes more than your own story.
caption:
Every sincere choice changes more than your own story.

One softened heart becomes hope for another.

One truthful soul becomes light for a community.

Ask Al-Muʿizz to honour what matters most—not your image, but your heart.

If this reflection stayed with you, save it and share it with someone who needs the reminder.

#DailyDhikr #IslamicReminder #DivineNames #SoulJourney #MercifulShades

title: The strongest heart isn't the one that burns the brightest.
caption:
The strongest heart isn't the one that burns the brightest.

It's the one that knows when to become still.

The soul never asks you to suppress your emotions.

It gently teaches you to transform them.

Real strength isn't found in louder words or stronger reactions.

It's found in the quiet courage to choose peace when anger asks for fire.

Perhaps healing begins the moment you stop fighting everyone else...

and finally allow your own heart to rest.

"Repel evil with what is better." — Qur'an (41:34)

#SoulVsEgo #InnerPeace #TakingMySoulHome #SpiritualHealing #HeartTransformation

title: Anger often promises strength.
caption:
Anger often promises strength.

But more often...

it leaves exhaustion behind.

Episode 14 explores the quiet turning point where the Ego grows tired of burning, and the Soul offers something unexpected:

Peace.

Not as surrender...

but as a deeper form of strength.

Sometimes the greatest victory isn't winning the argument.

It's refusing to let anger become your identity.

Watch Episode 14 — Anger Fades, and discover how calm can become the strongest voice inside you.

#SoulVsEgo #AngerFades #TakingMySoulHome #InnerTransformation #SpiritualReflection

title: I thought anger protected me.
caption:
I thought anger protected me.

I thought it made me stronger.

So I kept feeding the fire...

until I realized the flames weren't consuming anyone else.

They were consuming me.

I'm tired.

Maybe I don't need another battle.

Maybe what I've been searching for isn't victory...

it's peace.

#HealingTheEgo #SoulVsEgo #TakingMySoulHome #ChoosePeace #EmotionalHealing

title: There is a love
caption:
There is a love
greater than anything
this world can offer.

A love that knew you
before you were born.

A mercy that never grows tired.

A Lord who never walks away.

This Friday Dua is a prayer
to return to Allah
with the trust of a child—
believing that no one knows us better,
blesses us more,
or loves us more than Him.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

📖 "Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child."
— Sahih al-Bukhari 5999 · Sahih Muslim 2754

May Allah make our hearts gentle,
our faith unwavering,
and our souls forever secure in His love.

#Spirituality #IslamicQuotes #JummahPrayer #Sincerity #TrustInAllah

title: May this blessed Jummah remind you
caption:
May this blessed Jummah remind you
that no distance is too great,
no burden too heavy,
and no heart too broken
for the mercy of Allah.

May He replace your fears with trust,
your loneliness with His presence,
and your uncertainty with unwavering peace.

✨ Jummah Mubarak.

#Jummah #JummahMubarak #Dua #Deen #FridayBlessings

title: A child sleeps peacefully
caption:
A child sleeps peacefully
because they know someone is watching over them.

Faith invites us
to trust Allah
with that same certainty.

Even when people leave.

Even when answers are delayed.

Even when life feels uncertain.

Allah remains.

He sees every tear,
hears every whispered prayer,
and never abandons the heart that turns back to Him.

📖 "And He is with you wherever you are."
— Qur'an 57:4

Jummah Mubarak.

May Allah grant us hearts that rest in His presence and find peace in His endless mercy.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #Faith #MercyOfAllah

title: Some journeys cannot be measured in miles.
caption:
Some journeys cannot be measured in miles.

Some journeys begin when Allah calls.

The Night Journey reminds us that when Allah wills, distance folds, impossibilities become reality, and every hardship can become a doorway to nearness.

Before we witness this week's Breath of Return, prepare your heart to remember a night unlike any other—a night that continues to teach every believer that no distance is too great for the mercy of Allah.

"And Allah is the best of planners."

#ABreathOfReturn #NightJourney #IsraMiraj #IslamicReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Episode 13 is now available.
caption:
Episode 13 is now available.

This week's A Breath of Return reflects on one of the most sacred moments in Islamic history—the Night Journey (Al-Isrāʾ wal-Miʿrāj).

Without attempting to depict the Beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, this episode instead reflects on what the Night Journey teaches every heart:

• Distance disappears when Allah calls.
• Hardship can become a doorway.
• Prayer is our daily journey back to Allah.
• Nearness begins with surrender.

May every prayer become a small return to the One who is always nearer than we imagine.

Watch the full episode through the link in our bio.

#ABreathOfReturn #NightJourney #ProphetMuhammadﷺ #IslamicReflection #TakingMySoulHome

title: Every prayer is more than a routine.
caption:
Every prayer is more than a routine.

It is an invitation.

Every sincere sajdah...
every whispered duʿā...
every quiet remembrance...

...is a small journey back toward Allah.

The Night Journey reminds us that true nearness is never measured by distance, but by surrender.

May Allah make our hearts among those that always return to Him with sincerity, humility, and hope.

Aameen, Ya Rabbal 'Aalameen.

#ABreathOfReturn #Prayer #IslamicMotivation #SpiritualJourney #TakingMySoulHome

title: Financial stress doesn't only empty a bank account.
caption:
Financial stress doesn't only empty a bank account.

It slowly drains peace...
sleep...
confidence...
and sometimes hope.

Behind many smiles is someone quietly calculating bills, sacrifices, and impossible choices.

If that's you...

Know this:

Your worth has never been measured by your balance.

And your future has never been limited by today's numbers.

🤍 Share this with someone carrying more than they admit.

#FinancialStress #IslamicReminder #StressRelief #InnerPeace #TakingMySoulHome

title: Some burdens don't make noise.
caption:
Some burdens don't make noise.

They sit quietly on the dining table...
inside unopened envelopes...
inside unpaid bills...
inside exhausted hearts.

This episode is for everyone trying their best while secretly wondering how they'll make it through another month.

Allah reminds us that provision is never limited to what we can see.

He opens doors we never imagined.

When life feels impossible...

Tell Allah.

🎬 LET'S TELL ALLAH — Episode 7
Now streaming.

#LetsTellAllah #Quran #Faith #Provision #TakingMySoulHome

title: The biggest mistake stress makes us believe is this:
caption:
The biggest mistake stress makes us believe is this:

"Everything depends on me."

Faith gently reminds us:

"Do your best... then trust the One who controls what you never could."

Your effort matters.

But your provision has always been with Allah.

Sometimes relief arrives...

through a phone call.
through an opportunity.
through unexpected kindness.
through a door you never thought would open.

Keep trying.

Keep trusting.

❤️ Save this for the days your heart feels heavier than your wallet.

#TrustAllah #Rizq #Hope #IslamicReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Sometimes the hardest season isn't the one that breaks us.
caption:
Sometimes the hardest season isn't the one that breaks us.

It's the one that quietly prepares us.

What if the place you feel forgotten is actually where Ar-Rāfiʿ is shaping your next beginning?

Stay with this.

Your descent may already be becoming your elevation.

Follow the journey and return to this reminder whenever your heart feels lowered.

#MercifulShades #ArRafi #JourneyToTheBeloved #IslamicReflection #TakingMySoulHome

title: Ar-Rāfiʿ is the One who elevates.
caption:
Ar-Rāfiʿ is the One who elevates.

Not only our circumstances—

our hearts.

Our character.

Our consciousness.

Sometimes Allah raises us through patience before He raises us through blessings.

Come back to this Name whenever life feels heavy.

Save this reflection and continue the journey.

#NamesOfAllah #ArRafi #SpiritualGrowth #KnowAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: What if your next prayer wasn't asking to escape the trial—
caption:
What if your next prayer wasn't asking to escape the trial—

but asking to rise through it?

"Yā Rāfiʿ…

Raise my heart before You raise my circumstances."

If this prayer speaks to your heart, keep it close.

Follow for the next step on this journey Home.

#DailyDua #ReturnToAllah #HeartHealing #IslamicJourney #MercifulShades

title: The soul doesn't compete.
caption:
The soul doesn't compete.

It remembers.

There are moments when someone else's light feels brighter than your own.

Not because yours disappeared—
but because comparison covered it.

Your worth was never measured against another soul.

Allah did not create you as a copy.

He created you with a light that belongs only to you.

The journey isn't learning how to shine like someone else.

It's uncovering the light that has always been yours.

"Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth..."
— Qur'an (24:35)

#SoulVsEgo #InnerLight #TakingMySoulHome #FitrahJourney #SpiritualGrowth

title: Comparison steals peace before it steals joy.
caption:
Comparison steals peace before it steals joy.

The ego whispers,
"If they shine, you disappear."

But the soul answers differently.

Light is never a competition.

One person's brightness does not dim another's.

Episode 13 explores the quiet moment when jealousy begins to loosen its grip—and you realize that what you admired in others was never missing from you.

Your light wasn't lost.

It was simply hidden beneath comparison.

Watch Episode 13 — Jealousy Cracks, and rediscover the light that has been waiting beneath the shadows.

#SoulVsEgo #JealousyCracks #TakingMySoulHome #SpiritualReflection #InnerHealing

title: I spent so long measuring my life against everyone else's...
caption:
I spent so long measuring my life against everyone else's...

their success,
their peace,
their gifts,
their light.

Every comparison convinced me there wasn't enough for me.

But something changed.

Their light doesn't hurt like it used to.

Maybe because I finally stopped looking at what I lacked...

and started noticing what Allah had already placed inside me.

Maybe I was never behind.

Maybe I was simply looking in the wrong direction.

#EgoVsSoul #FreedomFromComparison #TakingMySoulHome #HealTheHeart #SpiritualAwakening

title: One of the most comforting truths
caption:
One of the most comforting truths
a believer can carry
is this—

Allah's mercy
surpasses even the deepest love
a mother has for her child.

This Friday Dua asks
for a heart that believes this completely.

A heart that trusts.
A heart that hopes.
A heart that never stops
running back to its Lord.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

📖 "Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child."
— Sahih al-Bukhari 5999 · Sahih Muslim 2754

May Allah keep our hearts innocent,
hopeful,
and forever amazed
by His limitless mercy.

#IslamicReminder #Mercy #JummahPrayer #Spirituality #Sincerity

title: May this blessed Jummah
caption:
May this blessed Jummah
bring serenity to your heart.

May Allah replace every fear
with trust,
every burden
with hope,
and every doubt
with certainty in His mercy.

May your soul always remember—

With Allah,
you are never alone.

✨ Jummah Mubarak.

#Jummah #JummahMubarak #Dua #Deen #FridayBlessings

title: Before the world taught us fear,
caption:
Before the world taught us fear,
our hearts knew how to trust.

This Friday Prayer is a longing
to return to that place again.

A heart that runs toward Allah
without hesitation.
A soul that rests
because it knows
its Lord is infinitely merciful.

Not because we are worthy.

But because His mercy
is greater than every mistake.

📖 "My mercy encompasses all things."
— Qur'an 7:156

Jummah Mubarak.

May Allah fill our hearts with the peace that comes from trusting His endless mercy.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #MercyOfAllah #Faith

title: Sometimes Allah asks us to move before He sends the miracle.
caption:
Sometimes Allah asks us to move before He sends the miracle.

Maryam (AS) stood alone, exhausted, yet she was still commanded to shake a palm tree that seemed impossible to move.

It wasn't because Allah needed her effort.

It was because He wanted her heart to trust Him through it.

Every sincere effort made for Allah is never wasted.

Keep moving.

Keep trusting.

His mercy always arrives at the perfect time.

#ABreathOfReturn #TrustAllah #IslamicReminder #MaryamAS #FaithJourney

title: Maryam (AS) teaches us that faith is never passive.
caption:
Maryam (AS) teaches us that faith is never passive.

When Allah commanded her to shake the palm tree, He was teaching every believer that miracles often begin with sincere effort.

Episode 12 of A Breath of Return reflects on trust, perseverance, and the beautiful mercy that descends upon hearts that continue returning to Allah.

Watch now.

May this breath strengthen your trust.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #MaryamAS #QuranReflection #IslamicReminder

title: Ya Rabb...
caption:
Ya Rabb...

When our strength feels small...

let our efforts remain sincere.

When our future feels uncertain...

let our trust remain in Your promise.

And when we stand in moments of loneliness...

send upon us the same ease You sent to Maryam (AS).

Take our souls Home to the peace that comes only from You.

Aameen.

#ReturnToAllah #IslamicReflection #TrustInAllah #SpiritualHealing #Aameen

title: Not every relationship ends because of anger.
caption:
Not every relationship ends because of anger.

Some slowly fade because two hearts stop noticing each other.

Sometimes the greatest act of love isn't buying flowers or planning surprises.

It's looking up.
Listening.
Asking,
"𝘏𝘰𝘸 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘺𝘰𝘶... 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺?"

The people closest to us often carry the heaviest invisible burdens.

Before today ends, pause for one minute and truly notice someone you love.

You might heal something you never knew was breaking.

❤️ Tag someone who deserves to feel seen today.

#Relationships #MentalHealth #Family #Couples #LetsTellAllah

title: Sometimes the loudest loneliness is felt while sitting beside someone you love.
caption:
Sometimes the loudest loneliness is felt while sitting beside someone you love.

This episode is for every husband and wife who kept giving, kept trying, and quietly wondered...

"𝘋𝘰𝘦𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘴𝘦𝘦 𝘮𝘺 𝘩𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘵?"

Allah reminds us that marriage was never meant to survive on routine alone.

It was built upon love... mercy... and seeing one another with compassion.

If your heart has been carrying this silent ache...

Tell Allah.

He never overlooks what people miss.

🎬 𝗟𝗘𝗧'𝗦 𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗟 𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗔𝗛 — 𝗘𝗽𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗱𝗲 𝟲
𝙽𝚘𝚠 𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚖𝚒𝚗𝚐.

#LetsTellAllah #RelationshipGoals #Love #Mercy #TakingMySoulHome

title: Love isn't only expressed through words.
caption:
Love isn't only expressed through words.

It's revealed through attention.

When someone feels truly noticed, they also feel valued.

Sometimes all a spouse needs isn't another solution...

It's someone who quietly says,

"I saw everything you did today."

Notice more.
Judge less.
Listen longer.

Because hearts don't always ask for attention.

Sometimes...

they're simply hoping someone notices.

❤️ What's one small thing your spouse does that often goes unnoticed?

#Marriage #LoveLanguages #HealthyRelationships #Communication #RelationshipAdvice

title: Sometimes the moment that feels like failure is actually mercy wearing a different face.
caption:
Sometimes the moment that feels like failure is actually mercy wearing a different face.

What if your life isn't falling apart... but being lowered so something stronger can take root?

Al-Khāfiḍ reminds us that humility isn't defeat. It's where new beginnings quietly grow.

Stay with this. Return whenever your heart feels heavy, and follow the journey Home.

#MercifulShades #AlKhafid #JourneyToTheBeloved #IslamicReflection #TakingMySoulHome

title: Al-Khāfiḍ — The One Who Lowers with Wisdom.
caption:
Al-Khāfiḍ — The One Who Lowers with Wisdom.

Not every descent is a loss.
Sometimes Allah lowers us to remove what pride could never surrender.

The deepest roots always grow in unseen places before the tallest trees rise.

Reflect on this Name today, and follow for the next step of the journey Home.

#NamesOfAllah #AlKhafid #SpiritualGrowth #HeartAwakening #TakingMySoulHome

title: Yā Khafid…
caption:
Yā Khafid…

Lower every burden my soul was never meant to carry.
Lower my pride before You lower my circumstances.
Lower every veil that keeps my heart from returning to You.

Come back to this prayer whenever life feels heavy, and let your heart breathe again.

#DailyDua #IslamicReminder #ReturnToAllah #MercifulShades #SoulJourney

title: The soul never asks you to become someone else.
caption:
The soul never asks you to become someone else.

It simply invites you to stop pretending.

Under every role you perform...
every image you protect...
every version of yourself built to impress...

there is someone quieter.

Someone lighter.

Someone Allah created before the world taught you to wear masks.

Your fitrah has never disappeared.

It has only been waiting patiently for you to come home.

Sometimes healing isn't becoming more.

It's remembering who you already were.

"…The natural way Allah created you upon…"
— Qur'an (30:30)

#SoulVsEgo #ReturnToYourself #TakingMySoulHome #Fitrah #SpiritualHealing

title: How much of who you are...
caption:
How much of who you are...

is actually you?

Sometimes pride doesn't shout.

Sometimes it hides behind perfection.
Approval.
Status.
An image carefully built for everyone else.

Then one quiet moment changes everything.

"I'm tired of pretending."

Episode 12 explores what happens when the ego grows weary of performance—and the soul gently calls you back to the person Allah created you to be.

The journey home doesn't begin by becoming someone new.

It begins by letting go of who you were never meant to be.

Watch Episode 12 — Pride Trembles.

#SoulVsEgo #PrideTrembles #TakingMySoulHome #SpiritualReflection #InnerTransformation

title: I spent so long protecting an image...
caption:
I spent so long protecting an image...

that I forgot the person beneath it.

I smiled when I felt empty.

I acted strong when I felt afraid.

I chased approval until I couldn't hear my own heart anymore.

The mask became so familiar...

I started believing it was me.

But pretending is exhausting.

And eventually...

even pride grows tired.

Maybe the first step toward healing
is admitting the performance is over.

#EgoVsSoul #DropTheMask #TakingMySoulHome #HealingBegins #InnerJourney

title: Allah sees beyond appearances.
caption:
Allah sees beyond appearances.

Beyond titles.
Beyond achievements.
Beyond everything the world celebrates.

He looks at the heart.

This Friday Dua is a prayer
to return to Allah
with the innocence of a child,
the humility of a servant,
and the sincerity of someone who knows
their Lord never turns away a heart that seeks Him.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

📖 "Allah does not look at your bodies or your appearance, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds."
— Sahih Muslim 2564

May Allah purify our hearts,
beautify our character,
and make every hidden intention a means of drawing nearer to Him.

#Sincerity #IslamicQuotes #JummahPrayer #Mercy #Spirituality

title: May this blessed Jummah become a new beginning.
caption:
May this blessed Jummah become a new beginning.

May Allah wash away every hidden burden,
replace every wound with mercy,
and fill your heart with the peace that comes from sincere remembrance.

May your soul become lighter,
your faith stronger,
and your love for Allah deeper with every breath.

✨ Jummah Mubarak.

#Jummah #JummahMubarak #Dua #Deen #FridayBlessings

title: The greatest journey is not from one place to another.
caption:
The greatest journey is not from one place to another.

It is from a hardened heart…
to one made soft by the remembrance of Allah.

This Friday Prayer is a plea for a heart free from pride,
untouched by bitterness,
and alive with sincerity.

A heart that forgives quickly,
loves sincerely,
and trusts its Lord completely.

📖 "Those who believe and whose hearts find comfort in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find comfort."
— Qur'an 13:28

Jummah Mubarak.

May Allah grant us hearts that are pure enough to recognize Him, gentle enough to love Him, and sincere enough to return to Him.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #PureHeart #Faith

title: There are wounds no one else can see.
caption:
There are wounds no one else can see.

The quiet fractures hidden beneath our smiles.

The places where the soul longs to become whole again.

Before healing begins, the heart remembers where it belongs.

Every return to Allah begins with a single sincere desire:
to become pure once more.

May He never let us lose that longing.

#ABreathOfReturn #PurityOfHeart #ReturnToAllah #IslamicReminder #FaithJourney

title: Some souls illuminate the world without seeking attention.
caption:
Some souls illuminate the world without seeking attention.

Fatimah (RA) embodied a purity that returned to Allah in every moment, a heart anchored in truth, and a quiet strength that never needed to raise its voice.

Episode 11 of A Breath of Return reflects on purity, sincerity, and the gentle light that grows when a heart continually returns to its Lord.

May her example inspire our own return.

Watch now.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #FatimahRA #IslamicReflection #SpiritualJourney

title: Ya Rabb...
caption:
Ya Rabb...

Let our hearts return to purity the way You love.

Let our souls become whole where only Your mercy can heal.

Let a little of the light You placed in the righteous settle gently within us.

Take our souls Home to the light we were always meant to return to—

the light that comes only from You.

Aameen.

#LightOfFaith #ReturnToAllah #IslamicReflection #SpiritualHealing #Aameen

title: Let's see what your heart says.
caption:
Let's see what your heart says.

Which hurts the most?

A) An enemy spreading lies.

B) A stranger judging you.

C) A friend betraying your trust.

The deepest pain usually doesn't come from strangers.

It comes from someone you never expected to hurt you.

Which one would hurt you the most?

👇 Comment A, B or C.

#Trust #Betrayal #IslamicReminder #LetsTellAllah #TMYSH

title: Some pain doesn't begin with harsh words.
caption:
Some pain doesn't begin with harsh words.

It begins with realizing...

the person you trusted
didn't protect your trust.

The screenshot.

The private conversation.

The betrayal.

The silence afterward.

Episode 5 of LET'S TELL ALLAH explores one of life's deepest emotional wounds.

WHEN TRUST IS BROKEN

Now Playing.

"Be patient, and your patience is only through Allah."
— Qur'an 16:127

New Episodes Every Wednesday.

#Friendship #IslamicSeries #FaithAndHealing #QuranReminder #TakingMySoulHome

title: Being betrayed can make you question everyone.
caption:
Being betrayed can make you question everyone.

It can make you build walls around your heart.

But don't let one person's betrayal become everyone else's sentence.

And never let human disappointment distance you from Allah.

People may break promises.

Allah never breaks His.

title: The soul does not deny that you were searching.
caption:
The soul does not deny that you were searching.

It only asks:
*where were you looking?*

Some emptiness does not come from lacking more.
It comes from running too long in the wrong direction.

You chased what glittered.
You reached for what felt full.
You held what looked like peace.

But the soul knows this:
what was meant to nourish you was never outside you.

It was waiting beneath the noise,
beneath the craving,
beneath the endless reaching—

for one moment of stillness,
one breath of return,
one quiet turning inward.

Because fullness begins when the chase ends.

caption:

After people.
After moments.
After anything that promises,

The one that tells you the ache was never solved by more chasing.
Because the world can dazzle your eyes,
but it cannot feed your soul.

caption:

The next version of me.
The next spark.
The next feeling.

Toward glitter.
Toward noise.
Toward whatever looked like it could quiet the ache.

But the ache stayed.

What if the emptiness was never from not having enough…
but from chasing what was never meant to fill me?

caption:

When certainty feels distant.
When standing firm feels heavier than we imagined.

It begins in Allah.

to remain with Allah when everything around you is trembling.

certainty that did not bend,
and a heart that returned fully to Allah.

This episode is not about worldly bravery.
It is about the kind of courage that is born from devotion —
the courage to stand firm in truth,
to walk the path of Allah without wavering,
and to let faith become stronger than fear.

Let our faith return to standing unshaken in Your name.

We are asking for the courage that keeps the soul upright before You.
The courage to remain truthful.
The courage to remain faithful.
The courage to keep walking toward You when the heart is tired and the road feels heavy.

the courage that comes only from You.

caption:

every illusion you protect…

But only because it breaks the chains

caption:
Ar-Razzāq — ٱلرَّزَّاقُ
The Provider. The Sustainer. The Giver of every form of rizq.

Rizq is not only money.

Rizq is:
• a healed heart
• a sincere friend
• emotional peace
• unexpected opportunities
• halal provision
• guidance after confusion
• and mercy that finds you at the right moment

When Maryam (AS) received fruits from different seasons, Allah showed humanity something eternal:

Your provision is not limited by logic.
Not by people.
Not by timing.
Not by impossibility.

Swipe through and reflect on the Name that nourishes both the body and the soul.

#99NamesOfAllah #IslamicQuotes #Rizq #MuslimContent #QuranReminder

title: Yā Ar-Razzāq…
caption:
Yā Ar-Razzāq…
The One who provides even when the world sees no way.

Not every rizq arrives as wealth.
Sometimes Allah sends:
— peace into a restless heart,
— kindness into your tongue,
— healing into your chest,
— and people whose presence feels like mercy.

This dua is for every soul quietly asking:
“Ya Allah… don’t let me feel forgotten.”

May Allah make us a source of ease, comfort, barakah, and gentle provision for others.

Ameen.

#ArRazzaq #IslamicReels #DuaForPeace #AllahProvides #MuslimReminder

title: Anger feels powerful in the moment.
caption:
Anger feels powerful in the moment.

It rises fast. Burns loud. Demands control.

But the soul asks a deeper question:
What if your anger is not strength…
but pain asking for protection?

Real strength is not found in destruction.
It is found in restraint.
In pausing before the reaction.
In choosing calm when the fire inside wants chaos.

Because some fires only leave ashes behind.

And some silences heal what rage never could.

“…and who restrain anger and who pardon the people – and Allah loves the doers of good.” (3:134)

#SoulVsEgo #InnerHealingJourney #SpiritualAwareness #TakingMySoulHome #EmotionalMastery

title: There is a voice that burns to survive.
caption:
There is a voice that burns to survive.

And another that asks:
What are you protecting beneath the fire?

One voice destroys to feel powerful.
The other reveals the wound beneath the rage.

Because anger is not always aggression.
Sometimes…
it is fear.
Pain.
Exhaustion.
A heart that forgot how to soften.

But the soul does not fight fire with more fire.

It responds with stillness.
With awareness.
With mercy.

Episode 4 — Anger
The Two Voices Inside You: SOUL vs EGO

Watch now. Reflect deeper. Save this for the moments you feel yourself burning.

#SoulVsEgo #AngerHealing #InnerConflict #TakingMySoulHome #SpiritualGrowthJourney

title: If I stop burning…
caption:
If I stop burning…
what will be left of me?

The anger protects me.
Keeps people away.
Keeps the pain hidden.
So I ignite everything around me before anyone gets close enough to see the hurt beneath it.

Because rage feels safer than vulnerability.

And destruction feels easier than honesty.

But the truth is:
the fire was never healing me.

It was only consuming me slowly.

#EgoVsSoul #HealingFromAnger #ShadowSelf #TakingMySoulHome #InnerTransformation

title: Truth is not only spoken.
caption:
Truth is not only spoken.
It is lived.

In loyalty.
In honesty.
In the quiet choices no one applauds.

This Friday Dua is not asking for power —
it is asking for purity of character.

To stand for justice without pride.
To remain loyal without hesitation.
To carry sincerity in both public and private.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

📖 “The truthful and trustworthy merchant will be with the Prophets, the truthful, and the martyrs.”
— Jamiʿ al Tirmidhi 1209

May Allah make our hearts truthful,
our intentions sincere,
and our faith unwavering.

#IslamicReminder #FridayBlessings #Sincerity #JummahPrayer #Faith

title: On this blessed Friday,
caption:
On this blessed Friday,
pause the noise of the world for a moment.

Return to your Lord quietly.
Speak to Him sincerely.
Ask Him for a heart that chooses truth
even when no one sees the struggle within.

May this Jummah bring light to your soul,
clarity to your path,
and peace to your inner world.

✨ Jummah Mubarak.

#Jummah #JummahMubarak #Spirituality #Dua #Deen

title: Some hearts do not bend before the world.
caption:
Some hearts do not bend before the world.

They remain anchored in truth…
even when truth feels heavy.

This Friday Prayer, ask Allah for a heart
that does not shake in confusion,
a tongue that speaks with honesty,
and a soul that walks with sincerity.

Like ʿUmar ibn al Khattāb —
may we carry conviction without arrogance,
strength without cruelty,
and faith without compromise.

📖 “Indeed, those who say, ‘Our Lord is Allah’ and then remain steadfast…”
— Qur'an 41:30

Jummah Mubarak.
May your steps remain firm upon truth.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #Truth #Faith

title: Not every fire in life is visible.
caption:
Not every fire in life is visible.

Some burn quietly inside the heart—
fear, pressure, anxiety, grief, exhaustion.

And sometimes…
it feels like you are standing too close to something overwhelming.

This is where Ibrahim AS stood.

Not untouched by danger—
but untouched by fear of anything except Allah.

✨ The miracle did not begin when the fire cooled.

It began when the heart surrendered before it did.

But what happens
when Allah commands fire itself?

➡️ Continue to the next post.

#ABreathOfReturn #IbrahimAS #IslamicReminder #TrustInAllah #SpiritualHealing

title: The fire was real.
caption:
The fire was real.

The danger was real.

But Allah said:

“O fire, be coolness and peace.”

And what was created to destroy…
became safety by His command.

✨ This is the heart of Ibrahim’s story:

Not merely surviving the fire—
but being held by Allah within it.

Because when Allah protects a servant,
even flames lose their power.

But our hearts carry fires too…

➡️ Continue to the next post.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #IbrahimAndTheFire #IslamicContent #Faith

title: Ya Rabb…
caption:
Ya Rabb…

Cool the hidden fires within us.

The anxiety we cannot explain.
The heaviness we quietly carry.
The fears we hide behind silence.

Wrap us in the same calm
You gave Ibrahim AS.

The same nearness.
The same protection.
The same peace that turns fear into safety.

Take our souls Home
into the mercy that cools what this world cannot.

✨ Aameen.

And maybe…
the fire will not destroy you.

Maybe it will bring you closer to Him.

#SpiritualReflection #IslamicPosts #DuaReminder #SoulJourney #PeaceInAllah

title: You take one step.
caption:
You take one step.
He comes faster.

This is not a distant Lord.
This is Al-Wahhāb — the One who gives, and gives again.

When you move toward Him,
He moves toward you with more.

So don’t wait for perfection.
Don’t wait for the “right moment.”

Just begin.

Because the moment you turn to Him…
He is already coming closer.

#HadithReminder #CloserToAllah #IslamicWisdom #Tawakkul #SeekAllah

title: You think your du‘ā’ is small.
caption:
You think your du‘ā’ is small.
You think your voice is quiet.

But with Al-Wahhāb…
nothing stays small.

What you ask…
He expands.

What you hope…
He elevates.

What you cannot even say…
He already knows.

So ask again.
But this time — ask knowing Who you’re asking.

#DuaReflection #SpiritualGrowth #IslamicContent #DivineResponse #FaithJourney

title: Sulaiman (AS) did not ask small.
caption:
Sulaiman (AS) did not ask small.
He asked from the One who gives without limit.

“My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom…”
And Allah — Al-Wahhāb — gave him what no one else had.

This is the nature of His giving.
Not restricted. Not calculated.

So don’t shrink your du‘ā’.
Expand your trust.

Because when you ask Al-Wahhāb,
you are asking the One who gives in ways you cannot imagine.

#AlWahhab #QuranReminder #DuaPower #IslamicReflection #TrustAllah

title: Faith is not only what you believe…
caption:
Faith is not only what you believe…
it is how you choose.

To love.
To give.
To hold back.

All for Allah.

When your actions are no longer about people,
but about Him —
your faith becomes complete.

Al-Wahhāb gives endlessly.
And He teaches us how to give with meaning.

Reflect on this.

#HadithReminder #IslamicWisdom #Sincerity #FaithInAction #DeenOverDunya

title: Not everything you receive…
caption:
Not everything you receive…
is meant to be spent.

Some things are meant to be protected.
Some are meant to shape you.
Some are meant to guide you back.

Al-Wahhāb doesn’t just give.
He gives with wisdom.

So pause and ask:
What has He given me…
and what am I doing with it?

Stay with this thought.

#SpiritualReflection #IslamicContent #DivineGifts #PurposeDriven #Tazkiyah

title: Guidance is not just given —
caption:
Guidance is not just given —
it is sustained.

The believer doesn’t only ask for more…
he asks to remain.

“Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us…”
This is the prayer of those who understand the gift.

Al-Wahhāb gives without limit.
But the greatest gift is a heart that stays aligned.

Return to this dua. Sit with it.

#AlWahhab #QuranReflection #IslamicReminder #HeartGuidance #FaithJourney

title: You thought what you have… is yours.
caption:
You thought what you have… is yours.

But Al-Wahhāb gives in ways we don’t always recognize:
a kingdom…
a cave…
a child…

Each gift is not a reward.
It’s a responsibility.

What if what you hold today
is not meant to define you…
but to refine you?

Watch this episode.
Then look at your life again.

#AlWahhab #IslamicReflection #SpiritualAwakening #FaithJourney #QuranStories

title: Not every gift shines.
caption:
Not every gift shines.
Some arrive quietly.

Some slow your life down.
Some take you away from noise.
Some reshape your heart before they change your world.

Al-Wahhāb doesn’t just give more…
He gives what brings you closer.

So the question is not:
“What did I receive?”

The question is:
“What is this gift making me become?”

Save this. Come back to it.

#NamesOfAllah #AlWahhab #SpiritualGrowth #IslamicContent #InnerJourney

title: Everything you have… was placed in your hands.
caption:
Everything you have… was placed in your hands.

Not by chance.
Not without purpose.

Yā Wahhāb…
teach me to use it well.

To turn blessings into goodness.
To turn moments into worship.
To turn what I have… into something that leads me back to You.

Let this be your du‘ā’ today.
And every day after.

#Dua #AlWahhab #IslamicReminders #MakeDua #ReturnToAllah

title: Pause.
caption:
Pause.

What you feel when you see someone shine…
is not always about them.

Sometimes, it’s a reflection
of something within you
that has been buried, ignored, or forgotten.

The soul doesn’t compete.
It reminds.

You don’t need their light—
you need to reconnect with your own.

“And do not crave what Allah has given some of you over others…” (4:32)

#SoulVsEgo #Jealousy #Tazkiyah #IslamicReminder #SpiritualAwareness

title: There is a voice that compares.
caption:
There is a voice that compares.

And a voice that understands.

One says:
“Why them?”

The other asks:
“What are you being shown?”

Jealousy doesn’t come to destroy you.
It comes to reveal you.

Because the pain you feel
is not their light—

it’s the distance from your own.

Episode 3 — Jealousy
The Two Voices Inside You: Soul vs Ego

Watch now. Reflect deeper.

#SoulVsEgo #InnerBattle #Jealousy #IslamicContent #SelfReflection

title: Why them?
caption:
Why them?

Why do they have what I don’t?
Why does their light feel like it’s taking something from me?

It doesn’t feel fair.
It doesn’t feel right.

Because when they rise…
something inside me feels smaller.

So I compare.
I question.
I resist.

But the truth is—
I’m not reacting to them.

I’m reacting to what I’ve lost within myself.

#Nafs #Jealousy #InnerStruggle #SelfAwareness #Ego

title: There are deeds no one applauds… yet they are heard in the heavens.
caption:
There are deeds no one applauds… yet they are heard in the heavens.

Allah does not measure your faith by what is visible—but by what is real within you.

This Jummah, seek a sincerity so pure…
that even your quiet actions echo in eternity.

📖 “Indeed, Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but rather He looks at your hearts and your deeds.”
— Sahih Muslim 2564

✨ Jummah Mubarak. Let your hidden عبادت be your greatest legacy.

#JummahMubarak #FridayPrayer #IslamicReminder #Sincerity #Deen

title: Not every step is seen…
caption:
Not every step is seen…
but every step is counted.

Walk toward Allah—
even if slowly, even if silently.

This blessed Friday, ask for a heart that seeks Him
more than it seeks the world.

✨ Jummah Mubarak. May your path lead to eternal peace.

#JummaMubarak #FridayMotivation #IslamicPost #SpiritualJourney #Prayer

title: The world sees what you show.
caption:
The world sees what you show.
Allah sees what you protect.

In your quiet moments…
in your unseen prayers…
in your silent struggles—

That is where sincerity lives.

📖 “And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion…”
— Qur'an 98:5

This Jummah, refine your intention.
Because what is hidden for Allah… is never lost.

✨ Jummah Mubarak. Choose sincerity over recognition.

#JummahReminder #FridayVibes #IslamicQuotes #Faith #JummahBlessings

title: There are moments in life where everything closes in.
caption:
There are moments in life where everything closes in.

Behind you—pressure.
Ahead of you—the impossible.

And you stand there…
unsure which way to move.

This is where Musa stood.
Not with certainty of what would happen—
but with certainty in Who was with him.

✨ Sometimes, the test is not the sea…
it is the moment before it moves.

But what happens when trust meets the impossible?

#ABreathOfReturn #IslamicReminder #TrustInAllah #SpiritualJourney #FaithOverFear

title: When Musa stood before the sea—
caption:
When Musa stood before the sea—
there was no visible path.

No bridge.
No escape.

But Allah does not need means.

He does not wait for a way to exist—
He creates it.

✨ The sea did not move because it could…
it moved because Allah commanded it.

This is your reminder:

What feels impossible to you
is effortless for Him.

But what does that mean for us…
when we face our own oceans?

➡️ Continue to the next post.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #IslamicContent #Dua #AllahIsAble

title: Ya Rabb…
caption:
Ya Rabb…
when fear surrounds us—
hold our hearts the way You held Musa.

When the path is not visible—
be our certainty.

When our seas rise—
make a way we cannot yet see.

Let Your nearness be the shore
we walk toward.

Because sometimes…
the miracle is not just the sea opening—

but the heart that remained steady
before it did.

✨ Aameen.

And maybe…
your path is already being written.

#SpiritualReflection #IslamicPosts #DuaReminder #FaithInAllah #SoulJourney

title: The scale is not what we think.
caption:
The scale is not what we think.

Elevation doesn’t come from proving yourself.
It comes from lowering your ego.

The more you surrender,
the more you are raised.

And the more you try to rise on your own—
the more you are brought down.

Al-Qahhār doesn’t just overpower the world…
He overpowers the ego within us.

So choose humility.
Even when it’s hard.

Especially when it’s hard.

#IslamicWisdom #HadithReminder #Humility #Tazkiyah #InnerWork

title: You feel stretched.
caption:
You feel stretched.
Out of place.
Out of control.

But what if…

You are not being lost—
you are being placed.

Every pressure has a purpose.
Every pull has direction.

Al-Qahhār doesn’t misplace you.
He positions you.

Even when you don’t understand it yet.

Stay with this.
Let it settle.

#DivinePlan #IslamicReflection #TrustAllah #SpiritualGrowth #FaithOverFear

title: There is only One who holds absolute power.
caption:
There is only One who holds absolute power.
No force competes. No outcome escapes.

Al-Qahhār is not loud —
He is inevitable.

Every path, every resistance, every illusion…
returns to Him.

And when you remember this,
your fear begins to loosen.

Because what feels overwhelming to you
is already under His control.

Return to that certainty.
Sit with it.

#AlQahhar #QuranReflection #IslamicReminders #Tawheed #SpiritualClarity

title: Even the strongest hearts seek protection.
caption:
Even the strongest hearts seek protection.

The Prophet ﷺ taught us
to ask Allah for refuge from being overpowered—
not just by people,
but by what weighs on the heart.

Grief.
Fear.
Pressure.
The silent heaviness no one sees.

And this is where Al-Qahhār meets you.

Not to overpower you—
but to overpower what overwhelms you.

Turn to Him with what feels heavy.
You were never meant to carry it alone.

#HadithReminder #AlQahhar #IslamicHealing #FaithStrength #DuaForStrength

title: You bend…
caption:
You bend…
but you don’t break.

You feel the pressure…
but something within you remains.

What if this isn’t the end of you—
but the reshaping of you?

Al-Qahhār does not crush the believer.
He crushes what tries to control them.

The fear.
The doubt.
The weight that was never yours.

And even in the tension…
even in the unknown…

you are still held.

Stay with this feeling.
Let it soften you, not scare you.

#AlQahhar #SpiritualStrength #IslamicReflection #FaithJourney #InnerTransformation

title: There is only One who truly holds power.
caption:
There is only One who truly holds power.

Not people.
Not fear.
Not the weight you carry in your heart.

ٱلْوَٰحِدُ — The One.
ٱلْقَهَّارُ — The One who overpowers everything.

What feels overwhelming to you…
is already under His control.

You are not surrounded by chaos.
You are surrounded by a plan you cannot yet see.

Let this settle in your heart today:
nothing can stand against what Allah has written.

#AlQahhar #QuranReflection #IslamicReminder #FaithOverFear #TrustAllah

title: You thought it was breaking you…
caption:
You thought it was breaking you…

The fall.
The rejection.
The silence no one understood.

But what if…
none of it was meant to end you?

Yūsuf was thrown into a well.
Forgotten. Betrayed. Buried in a story that didn’t look like promise.

And still—
nothing touched what Allah had written for him.

Al-Qahhār does not rush loudly.
He works quietly…
overpowering every force that tries to rewrite your destiny.

What you call “falling”
may be the beginning of your rise.

Stay with this. Reflect on it.
Follow to journey back Home.

#AlQahhar #QuranStories #SpiritualReflection #IslamicContent #TakingMySoulHome

title: Nothing overpowers what He has written.
caption:
Nothing overpowers what He has written.

Not people.
Not fear.
Not timing.
Not even your own doubts.

Al-Qahhār is the One who bends every false power
until only truth remains.

Not by force as we imagine—
but by quietly dissolving everything
that was never meant to stay.

You’re not being delayed.
You’re being aligned.

You’re not losing control.
You’re being returned to what was always yours.

Come back to this truth.
Let it settle.

#NamesOfAllah #AlQahhar #DivineDecree #IslamicReminder #FaithJourney

title: Some things don’t need to be fought…
caption:
Some things don’t need to be fought…
they need to be surrendered.

Yā Qahhār…

Overpower the fear I keep holding.
The thoughts I keep repeating.
The weight I was never meant to carry.

Break what blocks Your light in me.
And return me to who I truly am.

Because sometimes…
the strongest thing we can do
is let Allah take over what we cannot fix.

Sit with this du‘ā.
Whisper it slowly.
Come back to it.

#Dua #AlQahhar #IslamicHealing #SpiritualReset #HeartWork

title: You thought rising meant standing above others.
caption:
You thought rising meant standing above others.

But the soul teaches differently.

True elevation isn’t loud.
It isn’t proven by comparison.
It isn’t built on being seen as greater.

It is quiet. Grounded. Real.

Because humility doesn’t reduce you—
it releases you.

From the weight of proving.
From the fear of being small.

“The servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth with humility…” (25:63)

#Humility #SoulVsEgo #IslamicReminder #Tazkiyah #SpiritualGrowth

title: There is a voice that wants to rise above everyone.
caption:
There is a voice that wants to rise above everyone.

And another that asks… 𝘸𝘩𝘺?

One says: “𝘉𝘦 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘦𝘳.”
The other whispers: “𝘉𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘭.”

Pride feels like strength—
but often, it’s just fear wearing armor.

Fear of being unseen.
Fear of being small.

And so we build thrones…
only to sit trapped upon them.

Episode 2 — 𝙋𝙧𝙞𝙙𝙚
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝘄𝗼 𝗩𝗼𝗶𝗰𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂: 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗹 𝘃𝘀 𝗘𝗴𝗼

Watch now. Reflect deeper.

#Pride #InnerBattle #SoulVsEgo #IslamicContent #SelfReflection

title: I won’t bow.
caption:
I won’t bow.

Because if I do…
what am I?

If I’m not above them—
then I’m just like them.

And that feels like losing.

So I rise.
I compare.
I protect my place.

Even if it costs me peace.

Even if it isolates me.

Because pride doesn’t just lift you—
it separates you.

#Nafs #Ego #Pride #InnerStruggle #SelfAwareness

title: A life so sincere…
caption:
A life so sincere…
that its ending shook the heavens.

Sa‘d ibn Mu‘ādh (RA) did not live long—
but he lived true.

His loyalty, courage, and sincerity were not for people—
they were for Allah.

And that is what gave his life weight.

This Jummah, remember:
It is not how long we live—
but how true we live.

#JummahBlessings #HadithReminder #SahabaStories #IslamicInspiration #FaithOverFear

title: Strength is not always loud.
caption:
Strength is not always loud.

Sometimes, it is a quiet heart that refuses to break.
A soul that stays sincere—even when no one sees.

To stand for truth…
To stay loyal…
To remain sincere—

This is the path that reaches the heavens.

This Jummah, don’t seek to be seen.
Seek to be accepted.

#JummahReminder #StaySincere #IslamicMotivation #HeartOfFaith #SpiritualJourney

title: True faith is not spoken—it is lived.
caption:
True faith is not spoken—it is lived.

There were hearts before us that stood firm when it was hardest.
Hearts that chose loyalty over comfort, truth over fear, and sincerity over recognition.

Sa‘d ibn Mu‘ādh (RA) was one of them—
a man whose return shook the Throne, not by status, but by sincerity.

This Jummah, ask yourself:
What does my loyalty to Allah truly look like?

May we be among those who are true—quietly, deeply, and sincerely.

𝗝𝘂𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗵 𝗠𝘂𝗯𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗸 🤍

#JummahMubarak #QuranReminder #IslamicReflection #FaithAndSincerity #TakingMySoulHome

title: Not every miracle begins with light.
caption:
Not every miracle begins with light.

Some begin in silence.
In solitude.
In moments where no one understands you.

Maryam was chosen—
not because the path was easy…
but because her heart surrendered before it was shown.

Before Isa (AS)…
there was trust.
There was patience.
There was quiet strength.

✨ This is where divine openings begin.

But what does a heart like hers look like?

➡️ Continue to the next post.

#ABreathOfReturn #IslamicReminder #Maryam #SpiritualJourney #TrustInAllah

title: When Allah wills—
caption:
When Allah wills—
the impossible is no longer impossible.

He gave Maryam a miracle…
not through means we understand—
but through a command:

“𝗞𝘂𝗻.”

And it was.

This is not just a story of the past.
It is a reminder:

The same Rabb who created from nothing…
can open what feels closed in your life.

✨ Episode 2 — 𝘔𝘢𝘳𝘺𝘢𝘮 & 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘔𝘪𝘳𝘢𝘤𝘭𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘐𝘴𝘢

But before the miracle came…
Allah prepared her heart.

➡️ Continue to the next post.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #IslamicContent #Dua #Faith

title: Ya Rabb…
caption:
Ya Rabb…
open within us what You opened within Maryam.

Surrender that softens.
Purity that clears.
Trust that steadies.
Patience that dignifies.
Silence that protects.
Certainty that anchors.

Give us the strength to carry what is heavy—
and the courage to trust what we cannot yet see.

Because sometimes…
the miracle is not what happens around us—
but what You build within us first.

✨ Aameen.

And maybe…
your opening has already begun.

#SpiritualReflection #IslamicPosts #DuaReminder #SoulHealing #FaithInAllah

title: You are not waiting for Him.
caption:
You are not waiting for Him.

He is already reaching for you.

By night—
for those who fell in the day.

By day—
for those who fell in the night.

Not once.
Not occasionally.

Continuously.

Until the very end of time.
So what are you waiting for?

Return while the door is still open.

#HadithReminder #MercyOfAllah #Forgiveness #IslamicContent #HopeInAllah

title: You go…
caption:
You go…
then you get lost.

You try to grow…
but fall again.

And still—
guidance is not withdrawn.

Al-Ghaffār does not close the path.
He gently brings you back to it.

Again.
And again.

This is not failure.
This is being guided.

Come back—gently.

#GuidedByAllah #AlGhaffar #SpiritualGrowth #ReturnToAllah #IslamicReflection

title: You think time has passed.
caption:
You think time has passed.

That maybe…
you waited too long.

But Allah says—
He is Al-Ghaffār.

Not once.
Not sometimes.

Constantly.

Even now…
in this exact moment.

You are not outside His mercy.
You never were.

Stay with this.
Return quietly.

#AlGhaffar #QuranReflection #ReturnToAllah #DivineMercy #SpiritualReminder

title: What if your worst moments
caption:
What if your worst moments
were not the end of your story?

What if they were the beginning
of your return?

Allah says:
Even if your sins filled the sky…
and you turned back—
He would still forgive.

Not reluctantly.
Not conditionally.

But completely.

You are not too far.
You were never too far.

Reflect on this.
And come back.

#HadithReminder #MercyOfAllah #ForgivenessJourney #HopeInAllah #IslamicContent

title: You fall.
caption:
You fall.
You return.
You’re forgiven.

Then you fall again.

And still…
the door does not close.

This is not failure.
This is the rhythm of a soul being brought back.

Al-Ghaffār does not tire of forgiving—
so do not tire of returning.

Come back to this.

#Repentance #DivineMercy #IslamicReflection #KeepReturning #AllahForgives

title: You think forgiveness comes after perfection.
caption:
You think forgiveness comes after perfection.

But Allah says otherwise.

Not when you’re flawless.
Not when you’ve fixed everything.

But when you turn back…
again, and again, and again.

Al-Ghaffār is not waiting for a perfect version of you.
He is waiting for a returning one.

Stay with this.
Return quietly.

#AlGhaffar #QuranReminder #ReturnToAllah #SpiritualHealing #FaithJourney

title: You noticed their flaws.
caption:
You noticed their flaws.

But what if the discomfort you feel…
is something unhealed within you?

The journey doesn’t begin out there.
It begins quietly, within your own heart.

Stay with this. Reflect honestly.
Then come back to what truly matters.

Follow @TakingMySoulHome for reflections that bring you closer to yourself—and back to Allah.

#AlGhaffar #SelfReflection #TazkiyahJourney #IslamicGrowth #InnerHealing

title: You thought you went too far.
caption:
You thought you went too far.

You didn’t.

Al-Ghaffār forgives again and again—
even the parts of you you struggle to face.

Nothing about you is beyond His mercy.

Come back to this when your heart feels heavy.
And follow @TakingMySoulHome to keep returning.

#AllahsMercy #ForgivenessInIslam #SpiritualReminder #ReturnToAllah #FaithRenewal

title: We close doors on ourselves
caption:
We close doors on ourselves
that Allah never closed.

No one has the right
to make another soul feel too far gone.

If your heart is turning back—
don’t stop it.

Take the step. Stay on this path.
Follow @TakingMySoulHome and keep returning.

#ComeBackToAllah #IslamicReminders #HeartSoftening #MercyOfAllah #DeenOverDunya

title: Before you run toward what you want…
caption:
Before you run toward what you want…
pause.

Not every desire is guidance.
And not every urge is meant to be followed.

The soul doesn’t reject blessings —
it refines them.

It asks quietly:
𝘐𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘣𝘳𝘪𝘯𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘮𝘦 𝘤𝘭𝘰𝘴𝘦𝘳… 𝘰𝘳 𝘱𝘶𝘭𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘮𝘦 𝘢𝘸𝘢𝘺?

Because in the end,
it’s not what you gain —
it’s what it does to your heart.

“And whatever good you do, Allah knows it.” (2:197)

#SoulVsEgo #Tazkiyah #IslamicReminder #SpiritualClarity #QuranReflection

title: There is a voice that wants everything.
caption:
There is a voice that wants everything.
And a voice that asks 𝘸𝘩𝘺.

One rushes.
One reflects.

One says: “𝘛𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘢𝘭𝘭.”
The other whispers: “𝘜𝘯𝘥𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘵 𝘧𝘪𝘳𝘴𝘵.”

This is not a battle of right and wrong —
it’s a journey of awareness.

Because desire itself isn’t the problem…
direction is.

Episode 1 — 𝘋𝘦𝘴𝘪𝘳𝘦
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝘄𝗼 𝗩𝗼𝗶𝗰𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂: 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗹 𝘃𝘀 𝗘𝗴𝗼

Watch now. Return inward.

#SoulVsEgo #InnerBattle #IslamicContent #SpiritualJourney #SelfReflection

title: I want more.
caption:
I want more.
More success. More comfort. More recognition.

Because maybe…
if I have enough,
I’ll finally feel full.

The ego doesn’t ask questions.
It just reaches.

It doesn’t pause.
It doesn’t reflect.

It promises fullness —
but feeds on emptiness.

And the more you give it…
the more it asks.

#Nafs #Desire #InnerStruggle #SelfAwareness #DeenOverDunya

title: Not all days are the same.
caption:
Not all days are the same.
Friday is honored above all—
a day where creation began,
and a day where prayers rise differently.
Within it lies a moment
where du‘a is never rejected.
So ask.
With sincerity.
With hope.
With certainty.
Because this is not just another day—
this is your weekly لقاء with mercy.

#JummahReminder #HadithOfTheDay #FridayBlessings #IslamicQuotes #DuaTime

title: Jummah Mubarak ✨
caption:
Jummah Mubarak ✨
May this Friday soften what feels heavy,
heal what feels broken,
and guide your heart back
to a place of peace with Allah.
A day of نور.
A day of mercy.
A day of returning Home.
Take a breath.
Make a du‘a.
Send blessings upon the Beloved ﷺ.

#JummahMubarak #BlessedFriday #IslamicReminder #PeacefulHeart #DeenOverDunya

title: Some things are never spoken—
caption:
Some things are never spoken—
but nothing is ever unseen.
On this Jummah, remember:
Allah knows the quiet glances,
the hidden thoughts,
the وزن your heart carries in silence.
And still…
He invites you back.
Not because you are perfect—
but because He sees you completely.
So return with honesty.
Stand with sincerity.
Speak to Him with what you’ve been hiding.
Because the One who knows your depths
is also the One who heals them.

#JummahMubarak #HeartReflection #AllahKnows #SpiritualHealing #IslamicReminder

title: There are things you never say out loud.
caption:
There are things you never say out loud.

Not because they don’t matter…
but because they feel too small, too fragile, too hidden.

And yet—
Allah knows.

He sees the quiet hopes you barely allow yourself to feel.
The sincerity you overlook.
The longing you don’t know how to express.

Nothing within you is unseen to Him.

✨ This is where every return begins.

#ABreathOfReturn #IslamicReminder #HeartHealing #SpiritualJourney #AllahKnows

title: What if one quiet deed…
caption:
What if one quiet deed…
one unseen moment of sincerity…
became so beloved to Allah—

that He says to Jibreel:
“𝗟𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗲.”

And the heavens begin to know your name.

This is not a distant dream.
This is a possibility written into sincerity.

Episode 1 — Being Loved by the Beloved
is now a reminder, a duʿaa, a return.

🤍 Watch. Reflect. Return.

#TakingMySoulHome #ABreathOfReturn #IslamicContent #Dua #Faith

title: There is a kind of love
caption:
There is a kind of love
that begins in the heavens…
and is felt on earth.

A love where Allah calls your name—
and the angels respond.

A love that reaches hearts
you have never met.

Ya Rabb…
let us be among those You love.
Let our names rise gently in the unseen.

✨ Aameen.

#SpiritualReflection #IslamicPosts #DuaReminder #SoulJourney #FaithInAllah

title: Long before your first breath…
caption:
Long before your first breath…
your story was known.

Your form, your provision, your lifespan—
all written while you were still unseen.

This is the quiet power of Al-Bāriʾ—
the One who not only shapes the body,
but assigns the journey.

Nothing about your life is random.
Not your beginning.
Not your path.
Not your end.

You are unfolding exactly as written.

And what is written…
is never without wisdom.

#HadithReminder #Qadr #IslamicWisdom #TrustInAllah #SpiritualGrowth

title: Formed with purpose.
caption:
Formed with purpose.
Fitted into place.
Fulfilled through unfolding.

Al-Bāriʾ does not just create—
He assigns.

Your place, your timing, your path—
none of it is accidental.

Even the delays…
even the detours…

are part of how you are being brought forth.

You are not lost.
You are being positioned.

#SpiritualReflection #DivineTiming #AllahNames #InnerPeace #TrustAllah

title: You were not just created—
caption:
You were not just created—
you were perfected.

Before the world defined beauty,
Allah shaped you with intention, balance, and care.

Al-Bāriʾ does not create randomly.
He brings forth form with harmony—
every feature, every detail, every design.

Even what you question about yourself
was chosen with wisdom.

You are not incomplete.
You are precisely formed.

And what He perfects…
needs no comparison.

#QuranReflection #AlBari #IslamicReminder #DivineDesign #FaithJourney

title: We are shaped with care…
caption:
We are shaped with care…
but tested with ego.

The Prophet ﷺ taught us that even the smallest arrogance
can distance a heart from Jannah.

Not beauty.
Not success.
Not excellence.

But arrogance—
rejecting truth,
and looking down on others.

Al-Bāriʾ formed us with balance—
but it is humility that keeps us aligned.

The more we remember who created us…
the softer we become.

#Hadith #Humility #IslamicWisdom #Tazkiyah #HeartPurification

title: Shaped with wisdom.
caption:
Shaped with wisdom.
Set in place.
Sent into purpose.

Al-Bāriʾ does not create without direction—
He positions.

You are not here by chance.
You are placed.

Not early.
Not late.
Not misplaced.

Exactly where you were meant to be.

And every step forward…
is another unfolding.

#AlBari #AllahNames #SpiritualReflection #DivineTiming #InnerPeace

title: Before you had a name…
caption:
Before you had a name…
you had a form.

Before the world saw you…
you were already shaped.

Al-Bāriʾ brings creation into its destined form—
not randomly,
but precisely,
intentionally.

Your features, your nature, your story—
all chosen before you could choose anything.

You are not an accident of existence.
You are a deliberate creation.

And what He shapes…
has purpose.

#AlBari #QuranReflection #IslamicReminder #FaithJourney #SpiritualDepth

title: 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗮 𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 𝗱𝗿𝗮𝗳𝘁. 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝗽𝘂𝗿𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗲.

Al-Muṣawwir — the Divine Artist — formed every wound, every longing, every quiet part of you with perfect precision.

This du'ā is for the soul that forgot it was made with love.

#AlMusawwir #NamesOfAllah #Dua #IslamicReflection #TakingMySoulHome

title: There is no soul in existence shaped the way you were shaped.
caption:
There is no soul in existence shaped the way you were shaped.

ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ — Al-Muṣawwir. The Divine Artist. The Shaper of every inner world that has ever existed.

Not one soul among billions carries your exact configuration of memory, longing, wound, and wonder. The Artist who formed the galaxies also formed the precise texture of your consciousness — and He did not repeat Himself.

But here is what this Name reveals that we so rarely pause to receive: you were not only shaped for yourself. The same intentionality that crafted your inner world also designed the way your presence moves through others. Your softness was made to become someone's healing. Your resilience was woven to become someone's anchor. Your light was never only yours to keep.

You are a single thread. And a masterpiece within a masterpiece.

Episode 13 of Merciful Shades of the Beloved is here. Let it take you closer to Him. 🤍

▶️ Watch the full episode — link in bio.

#AlMusawwir #NamesOfAllah #99NamesOfAllah #IslamicCalligraphy #TakingMySoulHome

title: 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀. 𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝘂𝘀𝗵𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗸𝗲𝘀.
caption:
𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀. 𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝘂𝘀𝗵𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗸𝗲𝘀.

Al-Muṣawwir — the Divine Artist — did not shape you despite your breaks. He shaped you through them. Every memory you carry, every longing you can't quite name, every scar that changed the way you move through the world — none of it was random. All of it was deliberate. All of it was art.

This du'ā was written for the soul that sometimes forgets it was formed with intention. For anyone who has looked at their own inner world and wondered if it was too fractured, too complicated, too much — this prayer is a reminder that the Artist never makes mistakes.

You are not a rough draft. You are not unfinished in the way you fear. You are a soul being shaped, still, by the One who has always known exactly what He is making.

Sit with this du'ā. Let it find the places in you that have forgotten they were formed with love. 🤍

caption:
Beneath the noise —

beneath the fear, the pride, the restlessness —

there has always been something quieter.

Something that never left you. Even when you left it.

It has been standing in the light, waiting for you to turn around.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲. And it has never stopped calling.

caption:
Two forces. One body. One lifetime.

On the other — light. Still, ancient, patient beyond measure.

caption:

"You're not ready." "They don't understand you." "You deserve better than patience."

And you listened. Because it sounded so much like your own voice.

But there is another voice inside you. One that has been waiting.

title: Every step you take toward Jumu‘ah…
caption:
Every step you take toward Jumu‘ah…
is not just a step.

It is a year of reward.
A year of عبادت written quietly
for something as simple as showing up.

Walk with intention.
Arrive with presence.
Sit with a listening heart.

Jumu‘ah is not routine—
it is رحمة in motion.

#Jummah #Hadith #FridayBlessings #IslamicReminder #Barakah

title: Jumu‘ah Mubārak 🤍
caption:
Jumu‘ah Mubārak 🤍

peace to your heart,
light to your path,
and acceptance to your prayers.

title: When the call of Jumu‘ah is made,
caption:
When the call of Jumu‘ah is made,
Allah asks us to pause the world…
and return to Him.

Not because He needs us—
but because we need that moment
more than we realize.

Leave what is in your hands,
and answer the One
who holds your heart.

#Jummah #FridayReminder #SurahJumuah #ReturnToAllah #TakingMySoulHome

title: Before the journey begins…
caption:
Before the journey begins…
there is a moment of stillness.

A moment where your heart knows
something is about to change.

𝗔 𝗕𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗻 is coming.
Not to overwhelm you—
but to gently bring you back.

🌙 Coming soon.

#ComingSoon #IslamicReels #SpiritualAwakening #Reminder #SoulJourney

title: Not every return is physical.
caption:
Not every return is physical.
Some returns happen within.

This series is a collection of quiet moments—
where prayers rise, hearts soften,
and the unseen begins to respond.

𝗔 𝗕𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗻
